From: YANG Wen
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
wenyang@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
國際中醫藥循證醫學研討會—構建高質量臨床證據
【邀請函及海報徵稿】
尊敬的中醫藥業界同仁、學者及專業人士：
香港中文大學中醫學院謹定於 2026年12月5日（星期六） 舉辦「國際中醫藥循證醫學研討會—構建高質量臨床證據」。本次研討會匯聚多位國際及本地頂尖中醫藥與循證醫學專家，共同探討中醫藥臨床研究的最新進展與高質量證據的構建策略。我們誠邀廣大中醫藥從業員、研究人員及相關領域專業人士踴躍報名參加。
研討會詳情
● 日期：2026年12月5日（星期六）
● 時間：下午1時30分至6時10分
● 地點：香港中文大學康本國際學術園3號演講廳 (LT3)
● 語言：英語及中文
● 費用：免費
● 註冊中醫進修學分：CME-PP0018-SCM0537（4.5 分）
● 報名截止日期：2026年12月1日 ● 報名連結：https://clinic.scm.cuhk.edu.hk/ISECM/registration.aspx
主講嘉賓（排名不分先後）
● 卞兆祥教授（香港中醫醫院醫院行政總監）
● 周怡君教授（香港中文大學醫學院助理院長、內科及藥物治療學系副教授（臨床）、一期臨床研究中心外部事務策略總監）
● 李相勳教授（慶熙大學韓醫學院副院長兼教授）
● 林志秀教授（香港中文大學中醫學院院長、香港中文大學香港中西醫結合醫學研究
所所長）
● 溫澤淮教授（廣東省中醫院藥物臨床試驗機構副主任兼教授）
循證醫學研究海報展示—徵稿邀請
本次研討會特別設有循證醫學研究海報展示，旨在提供交流與展示最新科研成果的平台。歡迎各位研究人員及業界同仁踴躍投稿！
● 截稿日期：2026年11月13日
● 投稿詳情及指引：請參閱會議網站（https://clinic.scm.cuhk.edu.hk/ISECM/registration.aspx）
主辦及支持單位
● 主辦單位：香港中文大學醫學院中醫學院
● 合辦單位：中國中醫藥循證醫學中心協作網絡建設單位、香港中文大學香港中西醫結合醫學研究所、香港中文大學中醫專科診所暨臨床教研中心
● 支持單位：香港中文大學粵港澳大灣區發展辦公室
查詢及聯絡
● 電郵：isebcm.scm@cuhk.edu.hk
● 電話：(852) 3943 3440 / (852) 3943 1551
期待您的參與，共同推動中醫藥循證醫學的發展！
香港中文大學中醫學院 敬啟
International Symposium on Evidence-Based Chinese Medicine: Constructing High-Quality Clinical Evidence
[Invitation & Call for Posters]
Dear Colleagues and Professionals in Chinese Medicine,
The School of Chinese Medicine, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK), cordially invites you to attend the "International Symposium on Evidence-Based Chinese Medicine: Constructing High-Quality Clinical Evidence" to be held on Saturday, 5 December 2026. Bringing together leading international and local experts, this symposium will focus on the latest developments in clinical research and strategies for constructing high-quality evidence in Chinese Medicine. We welcome all Chinese medicine practitioners, researchers, and healthcare professionals to join us.
Symposium Information
● Date: Saturday, 5 December 2026
● Time: 1:30 p.m. – 6:10 p.m.
● Venue: LT3, Yasumoto International Academic Park, CUHK
● Language: English & Chinese
● Fee: Free
● CME Accreditation: CME-PP0018-SCM0537 (4.5 Points)
● Registration Deadline: 1 December 2026 ● Online Registration: https://clinic.scm.cuhk.edu.hk/ISECM/registration.aspx
Featured Speakers
● Prof. BIAN Zhaoxiang — Hospital Chief Executive, The Chinese Medicine Hospital of Hong Kong
● Prof. CHOW Yee Kwan Elaine — Assistant Dean (Health Systems), Faculty of Medicine, CUHK; Associate Professor (Clinical), Department of Medicine and Therapeutics, CUHK; Director of External Affairs Strategy, Phase I Clinical Trial Centre, CUHK
● Prof. LEE Sanghoon — Deputy Director, International Education Institute of Korean Medicine; Professor, College of Korean Medicine, Kyung Hee University
● Prof. LIN Zhi-Xiu — Director and Professor, School of Chinese Medicine, CUHK; Director, The Hong Kong Institute of Integrative Medicine, CUHK
● Prof. WEN Zehuai — Director and Professor, Center for Clinical Research, Guangdong Provincial Hospital of Chinese Medicine
Call for Poster Submissions
We are pleased to announce that a Poster Exhibition on Evidence-Based Medicine Research will be featured at the symposium. We invite interested researchers and practitioners to submit their work to showcase their latest scientific achievements.
● Submission Deadline: 13 November 2026
● Submission Guidelines: Please refer to the official conference website (https://clinic.scm.cuhk.edu.hk/ISECM/registration.aspx).
Organizers & Supporters
● Organizer: School of Chinese Medicine, Faculty of Medicine, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
● Co-Organizers: Shenzhen Research Institute, CUHK; Sub-Center of the China Center for Evidence-Based Traditional Chinese Medicine; Hong Kong Institute of Integrative Medicine, CUHK; The Chinese University of Hong Kong Chinese Medicine Specialty Clinic cum Clinical Teaching and Research Centre
● Supporting Unit: Office for Greater Bay Area Developments, CUHK
Enquiries & Contact
● Email: isebcm.scm@cuhk.edu.hk
● Tel: (852) 3943 3440 / (852) 3943 1551
We look forward to your active participation!
Sincerely,
School of Chinese Medicine
The Chinese University of Hong Kong
View Count

https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

''科学与中国''-仰望星空,探索极致宇宙-''院士进校园''天文物理学名师讲堂
"Science and China" 2026-Distinguished Academician Lecture Series: Gaze at the Stars, Explore the Extreme Universe
“科学与中国——千名院士·千场科普”是由中国科学院学部发起、中国科学院等单位共同主办的科普行动，旨在弘扬科学精神、普及科学知识，激发公众特别是青年学子的科学兴趣与创新热情。本次活动由中国科学院紫金山天文台与香港中文大学联合举办，特邀崔向群院士、林海青院士莅临中大，围绕光学天文观测、理论计算与超导物理等前沿领域开展科普讲座，展现我国科技创新实力，启迪青年学子的科学兴趣与探索精神。
【活动详情 Event Details】
日期 Date：
2026年11月13日（星期五）/ 13 November 2026 (Friday)
时间
Time：
下午 3:00 – 5:45 (3:00 PM – 5:45 PM)
地点
Venue：
香港中文大學鄭裕彤樓鄭家純國際會議中心1樓（地下）LT1B, G/F, Cheng Yu Tung Building (CYT), CUHK
主办机构
Organizers：
中國科學院紫金山天文台、香港中文大學
承办单位
Co-organizers：
香港中文大學香港極地科學創新中心、粵港澳大灣區發展辦公室、深圳研究院
语言
Language：
普通話 (Putonghua)
【主讲嘉宾
Keynote Speakers】
崔向群 院士 (Academician XIANGQUN CUI)
中国科学院院士、南京天文光学技术研究所研究员
国家重大科技基础设施大天区面积多目标光纤光谱望远镜（LAMOST）总工程师
林海青 院士 (Academician HAIQING LIN)
中国科学院院士、浙江大学物理学院院长
凝聚态物理与计算物理知名专家
【活动流程
Rundown】
15:00 – 15:30
| 中大领导致辞、颁发纪念品及大合照 (Opening Remarks, Souvenir Presentation & Group Photo)
15:30 – 16:25
|

「嶺南文化與世界」公開講座系列2026──藝文嶺南：工藝、詩畫與人文景觀，由香港中文大學中國文化研究所嶺南文化研究計劃與香港公共圖書館聯合主辦，首場講座在 10 月 25 日圓滿結束，第二場講座將於 11 月 28 日繼續在香港中央圖書館演講廳舉行，誠邀大家參加！
兩場專題講座聚焦嶺南在跨域交流中的文化生產與藝術創造，從清代廣州工藝實踐與嶺南羅浮人文地景兩個主題切入。一方面，探討廣東銅胎琺瑯器如何在中外貿易背景下融合西洋裝飾元素，體現廣州工匠對外來技術與審美的創新轉化；另一方面，考察蘇軾嶺南詩文對地方知識、人文景觀與文化記憶的建構作用，以及清代與之相關的《羅浮香影圖》。透過工藝、詩畫與人文景觀的視角進行觀察，本系列將展現嶺南文化在跨域和歷史互動中的創新活力。
本講座系列為香港研究資助局協作研究計劃「嶺南文化與世界」項目（2023–2026）活動，亦是弘揚中華文化系列的活動之一。

Art and Literature of Lingnan: Craftsmanship, Poetic Painting, and Humanistic Landscape, Public Lecture Series on “Lingnan Culture and the World” 2026
The Public Lecture Series on “Lingnan Culture and the World” 2026, themed “Art and Literature of Lingnan: Craftsmanship, Poetic Painting, and Humanistic Landscape” and jointly organised by the Institute of Chinese Studies of the Chinese University of Hong Kong and the Hong Kong Public Libraries. The first lecture was successfully held on 25 October. The second lecture will take place at the Lecture Theatre of the Hong Kong Central Library on 28 November.
The two lectures, one focused on the craftsmanship of the region during the Qing
era, and the other on the humanistic landscape of Luofu, reveal how cross-regional interactions drove cultural and artistic production in Lingnan. The first lecture looks at how China’s trade with the West introduced Western decorative elements into Canton enamelled copperware, showcasing Guangzhou craftsmen’s innovative reinterpretation of Western techniques and aesthetics. The second lecture shifts focus to Su Shi’s Lingnan-themed verses, examining the construction of Lingnan’s humanistic landscape and cultural memory, as well as the creation of the
Paintings of Fragrant Dream of Luofu
during the Qing
dynasty. Approaching the core theme through the lens of craftsmanship, poetic painting, and humanistic landscape, this series reflects the innovative dynamics of Lingnan culture in cross-regional and historical interactions.
This public lecture series is part of RGC Collaborative Research Project “Lingnan Culture and the World” (2023–2026) and is also one of the activities in the Chinese Culture Promotion Series.

summaryEvidence: 2026/10/30 Seminars / Forums / Programmes / Workshops [JOIN US]Art and Literature of Lingnan: Craftsmanship, Poetic Painting, and Humanistic Landscape, Public Lecture Series on “Lingnan Culture and the World” 2026, jointly organised by Institute of Chinese Studies, CUHK, and Hong Kong Public Libraries 「嶺南文化與世界」公開講座系列 2026──藝文嶺南：工藝、詩畫與人文景觀，香港中文大學中國文化研究所嶺南文化研究計劃及香港公共圖書館聯合主辦 - Institute of Chinese Studies From: Whitney Sia ics-lingnan@cuhk.edu.hk - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 「嶺南文化與世界」公開講座系列2026──藝文嶺南：工藝、詩畫與人文景觀，由香港中文大學中國文化研究所嶺南文化研究計劃與香港公共圖書館聯合主辦，首場講座在 10 月 25 日圓滿結束，第二場講座將於 11 月 28 日繼續在香港中央圖書館演講廳舉行，誠邀大家參加！ 兩場專題講座聚焦嶺南在跨域交流中的文化生產與藝術創造，從清代廣州工藝實踐與嶺南羅浮人文地景兩個主題切入。一方面，探討廣東銅胎琺瑯器如何在中外貿易背景下融合西洋裝飾元素，體現廣州工匠對外來技術與審美的創新轉化；另一方面，考察蘇軾嶺南詩文對地方知識、人文景觀與文化記憶的建構作用，以及清代與之相關的《羅浮香影圖》。透過工藝、詩畫與人文景觀的視角進行觀察，本系列將展現嶺南文化在跨域和歷史互動中的創新活力。 本講座系列為香港研究資助局協作研究計劃「嶺南文化與世界」項目（2023–2026）活動，亦是弘揚中華文化系列的活動之一。 報 名： 按此 第一講 來自西洋的靈感 —— 清代廣東銅胎琺瑯的創意轉譯 講 者： 尹翠琪教授 香港中文大學藝術系副教授 日 期： 10 月 25 日（星期日） 時 間： 10:30 a.m. – 12:00 noon →→→ 講座摘要 ←←← 第二講 蘇軾與嶺南文化地景——從地方書寫到《羅浮香影圖》的跨地域傳播 講 者： 陳芳芳教授 香港浸會大學中文、歷史、宗教及哲學學部歷史系助理教授 日 期： 11 月 28 日（星期六） 時 間： 2:30 p.m. – 4:00 p.m. →→→ 講座摘要 ←←← 地 點： 香港中央圖書館地下演講廳 查 詢： 2921 0285 / 3943 7382 網 頁： 香港公共圖書館 www.hkpl.gov.hk 香港中文大學中國文化研究所 www.ics.cuhk.edu.hk **粵語主講** **請於講座舉行前15分鐘入座** **免費入場，座位有限，請報名留座** * 香港研究資助局協作研究計劃「嶺南文化與世界」項目（ 2023 –2026） Art and Literature of Lingnan: Craftsmanship, Poetic Painting, and Humanistic Landscape, Public Lecture Series on “Lingnan Culture and the World” 2026 The Public Lecture Series on “Lingnan Culture and the World” 2026, themed “Art and Literature of Lingnan: Craftsmanship, Poetic Painting, and Humanistic Landscape” and jointly organised by the Institute of Chinese Studies of the Chinese University of Hong Kong and the Hong Kong Public Libraries.

Registration: Click here Lecture 1 Inspiration from the West──Creative Interpretation as Reflected in Qing -Dynasty Canton Enamelled Copperware Speaker: Professor WAN Chui Ki, Maggie Associate Professor, Department of Fine Arts, CUHK Date: 25.10.2026 (Sunday) Time: 10:30 a.m. – 12:00 noon →→→ Abstract ←←← Lecture 2 Su Shi and the Cultural Landscape of Lingnan: From Writing Local to Border-Crossing Transmission of the Paintings of Fragrant Dream of Luofu Speaker: Professor CHEN Fong Fong Assistant Professor, Department of History, Academy of Chinese, History, Religion and Philosophy, HKBU Date: 28.11.2026 (Saturday) Time: 2:30 p.m. – 4:00 p.m. →→→ Abstract ←←← Venue: Lecture Theatre, G/F, Hong Kong Central Library Enquiries: 2921 0285 / 3943 7382 Websites: Hong Kong Public Libraries www.hkpl.gov.hk Institute of Chinese Studies, CUHK www.ics.cuhk.edu.hk **Conducted in Cantonese** **Please arrive 15 minutes prior to the talk for admission** **Free admission by reservation.

From: Global Business Programmes

Dear first-year students,
Ready to transform your university experience and stand out in today’s competitive business landscape?
The
International Business and Chinese Enterprise (IBCE)
and
Asian Business Studies (ABS)
transfer-in programmes are designed to cultivate regional expertise across diverse business contexts, while developing career readiness, professional networks, and focused skill sets.
To enhance your understanding of the programme features, application procedures, and selection process, an information and networking session will be held on
Nov 16
. You will also have the opportunity to meet IBCE and ABS students to hear about their firsthand experiences.
Please find the details below:
IBCE and ABS Information and Networking Session
Date: Nov 16, 2026 (Mon)
Time: 6:30 – 8:30pm
(light refreshments will be provided)
Venue: CYT203
Registration:
Click Here
(Deadline: by Nov 12, 2026)
Remarks: Registration is required to attend the session. Successful registrants will receive a confirmation e-mail closer to the event date.
About IBCE and ABS
IBCE – A Complete US-China Experience
In partnership with the University of South Carolina's Darla Moore School of Business, IBCE offers an unparalleled bi-continental education that develops your understanding of the US and Chinese markets.
Exclusive Bi-continental Cohort Exchange
: Gain international perspective and cultural fluency through a full year exchange in the US, building lifelong global connections.
Cutting-edge Business Training with Strong China Focus
: Develop your business acumen and regional expertise through specialized courses, China study trips, and direct connections with leading enterprises for long-term career success.
High-achieving Programme Network:
Learn alongside driven peers and connect with a powerful alumni network to accelerate your career development.
ABS – Your Personalised Gateway to Asia
ABS provides numerous avenues for exploring the world’s most vibrant economic region, allowing you to tailor your experience to your academic and career goals.
Flexible Exchange Opportunities in Asia:
Choose up to two exchanges across six Asian hubs on your own schedule for a unique regional exposure and cultural experience.
Practical Business Training with Asian Focus:
Gain tailored professional training, tackle real-world Asian business challenges through a corporate project, and explore diverse markets via study trips across Asia.
Vibrant Asian Community:
Connect with a multicultural programme community spanning Asia, gaining a distinct advantage in navigating diverse business environments.
To learn more about our programme, you may also refer to the
IBCE
and
ABS
Programme Brochures.
Should you have any questions, please feel free to contact Mr. Dennis Wong, Programme Manager at
denniswong@cuhk.edu.hk
.
We look forward to seeing you at the event.
Best regards,
Global Business Programmes
Undergraduate Office
CUHK Business School
4/F, Cheng Yu Tung Building, 12 Chak Cheung Street, Shatin, Hong Kong

Invitation to Participate in Semester at Sea Shipboard Welcoming Event (10 December 2026)  - Office of Academic Links
From: Martina NGAI
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
martinangai@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Dear students,
Semester at Sea (SaS) is a multi-country study abroad programme that brings together students from around the world to live, learn, and travel aboard a floating campus. Students earn academic credit through courses taught by distinguished faculty while visiting multiple countries across several continents, combining rigorous academics with experiential and intercultural learning. The SaS hosts CUHK students each year. The programme typically has eight stops around the world, including Hong Kong.
SaS is inviting the CUHK community aboard during its docking in Hong Kong on 10 December 2026 (Thurs).
It is a valuable opportunity to learn more about university life on board and to foster cultural and academic exchange among students and scholars. Studying aboard a floating campus is a distinctive and enriching experience, and it offers a useful preview for students who may be considering future exchange opportunities. The Shipboard Welcome Event includes a ship tour, an academic exchange, and lunch with SaS students on board. Please see the table below for details of the event:
Theme
SaS Shipboard Welcome Event
Venue
MV World Odyssey, Tsim Sha Tsui Ocean Terminal
Program Date
10 December 2026 (Thursday) 1000-1300
Objectives
To gain first-hand insight into life and study aboard a floating campus
To engage in intercultural and academic dialogue with international students and faculty
Connect their classroom learning with a broader global perspective
Activities
Ship tour
Academic exchange with students and faculty on board
Lunch with SaS students in the dining hall on board
Eligibility
CUHK full-time undergraduate students from all disciplines are welcome to apply
Have a good command in English
Have a good academic performance
Outreach/ exchange experiences will be an advantage
Application
Interested students should complete the
online application form
by 12:00 noon on Wednesday, 4 November
,
and submit their supporting documents, including an unofficial transcript, a CV, an English language qualification (if any).
More Information
Please refer to the
SaS program website
for more details.
If you are interested to join the Shipboard Welcome Event, please complete and
submit the application form before 12nn on November 4, 2026 (Wed).
Should you have any question, please feel free to contact Ms Martina Ngai via
martinangai@cuhk.edu.hk
or Ms. Vanessa IP via
vanessaip@cuhk.edu.hk
.

Participant call for an fMRI experiment  - Prof. LIU Xiaonan, Department of Psychology
From: SHI Aike
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
Ak-Shi@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Hi all,
We are recruiting participants for an fMRI (functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging) experiment on learning and memory. The formal experiment will be an one-shot MRI scanning session taking place at the
Prince of Wales Hospital
. The estimated duration of the experiment is about
90 minutes
and you will receive
HK$200
immediately after finishing it as remuneration. The MRI scanning itself is harmless to you but potential injuries can occur (e.g., when metals are implanted in your body), so a safety screening will be performed before the experiment.
Interested students can email the experimenter (Ak-Shi@link.cuhk.edu.hk) for registration, and we will reply with available timeslots for both saftety check and formal experiment.
Please kindly note that students who have participated in our behavioral study (which were carried out by the same experimenter
Aike Shi
)
in the past three months
cannot attend the current experiment. Thanks for your understanding.
Best,
Aike Shi
Memory Lab

Experiencing Chinese Culture Series 2026-27 – Chinese Calligraphy Workshop (Advanced) Application Open for now 中國文化體驗系列 2026-27──中國書法進階班 - 接受報名 - Institute of Chinese Studies
From: Amber Lam
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ics-activities@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Experiencing Chinese Culture Series 2026-27 – Chinese Calligraphy Workshop (Advanced)
Date: 25 November; 2, 9, 16, 23 & 30 December 2026 and 6, 13, 20 & 28 January 2027 (Wednesdays; except for 28 January; total 10 lessons)
Time: 6:00 p.m. - 7:30 p.m.
Venue: Experiential Learning Space, 1/F, West Wing, Art Museum, CUHK
Target Audience: CUHK Students, Staff and Alumni
Language: Cantonese
Registration:
Click here
Enquiries: 3943 5976 /
ics-activities@cuhk.edu.hk
For details, please refer to the poster (Chinese version only).
活動簡介
：
本課程為中國書法進階班，主要教授行書和草書，旨在透過介紹和臨習二王體系帖學經典，讓學員漸進掌握行、草書的書寫技巧和賞鑒，加深對書法的認識，增進對中國文化藝術的熱愛。
導師簡介：
陳冠男博士，畢業於香港中文大學藝術系，現職中大文物館中國書畫主任（研究員），研究興趣為明清至近現代書畫。曾策劃多個展覽並編撰圖錄，最新近者是「香江藏珍——香港三大古書畫收藏」 （2025，與劉湘瀅合作）。其他曾參與撰寫之圖錄包括：《蓋蒂基金會贊助中國書畫在線圖錄》、「北山汲古系列：中國書法、中國繪畫、碑帖銘刻拓本」、《明畫全集．董其昌卷》等；另合編撰寫《丁衍庸書法》等專書。2018-19年度獲選為「利榮森紀念訪問學人」，任美國普林斯頓大學藝術與考古系唐氏東亞藝術中心及藝術博物館訪問學人。研究之餘也積極參與各種書畫展覽和比賽，並獲殊榮，作品為香港及海內外公私收藏。
上課日期：
2026年11月25日；12月2、9、16、23、30日；2027年1月6、13、20、28日（共10堂；逢星期三，1月28日除外）
* 2027年1月28日（星期四）午間將舉行揮春書寫暨課程總結活動，學員必須出席。

：晚上6時至7時30分（1月28日：中午12時30分至下午2時）

活動簡介
：
本課程為中國書法進階班，主要教授行書和草書，旨在透過介紹和臨習二王體系帖學經典，讓學員漸進掌握行、草書的書寫技巧和賞鑒，加深對書法的認識，增進對中國文化藝術的熱愛。
導師簡介：
陳冠男博士，畢業於香港中文大學藝術系，現職中大文物館中國書畫主任（研究員），研究興趣為明清至近現代書畫。曾策劃多個展覽並編撰圖錄，最新近者是「香江藏珍——香港三大古書畫收藏」 （2025，與劉湘瀅合作）。其他曾參與撰寫之圖錄包括：《蓋蒂基金會贊助中國書畫在線圖錄》、「北山汲古系列：中國書法、中國繪畫、碑帖銘刻拓本」、《明畫全集．董其昌卷》等；另合編撰寫《丁衍庸書法》等專書。2018-19年度獲選為「利榮森紀念訪問學人」，任美國普林斯頓大學藝術與考古系唐氏東亞藝術中心及藝術博物館訪問學人。研究之餘也積極參與各種書畫展覽和比賽，並獲殊榮，作品為香港及海內外公私收藏。

title: 【Earn HK$500 coupon】 Recruiting adults (aged 18-65) to participate in research on online therapy for insomnia 【可獲得 500元現金券】招募成年人 (18-65歲)參與失眠的數碼化治療研究
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/10/30
»
Announcements
【Earn HK$500 coupon】 Recruiting adults (aged 18-65) to participate in research on online therapy for insomnia 【可獲得 500元現金券】招募成年人 (18-65歲)參與失眠的數碼化治療研究 - Psychiatry
From: Charis
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
mastersleep@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
你是否經常在床上輾轉難眠，夜醒或早醒？你並不孤單——許多人都面臨著同樣的問題。我們誠邀您參與研究，讓專業數碼化治療助你改善睡眠！
研究目的
本研究旨在評估市民對數碼化失眠認知行為治療聊天機器人的遵從性，以及其對改善睡眠問題的效果。
治療方式
· 由專業臨床心理學家及精神科醫生設計的電子化治療
· 完全免費
參與資格
· 18至65歲能說廣東話流利溝通（能流利閱讀並理解廣東話）的香港居民
· 在過去一個月內，每週至少三晚出現睡眠困擾
· 最近四周或以上無需長期服藥
參與研究，獲得獎勵！
完成所有治療及後續測試後，您可獲得高達500港幣。
如何加入？
請點擊以下連結進行註冊，並回答幾條簡單問題。研究員將聯絡適合的參加者，詳細解釋研究內容：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_4UPFh054GtJGXX0
聯絡我們
如有任何疑問，請於辦公時間內致電 6115-0322 與研究助理聯絡。
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Do you often toss and turn in bed, wake up frequently at night, or wake up too early? You are not alone—many people experience the same challenges. We invite you to participate in our study and explore professional digital treatment to improve your sleep!
Purpose of the Study
This research aims to evaluate the public’s adherence to a digital insomnia cognitive behavioural therapy chatbot and assess its effectiveness in improving sleep problems.
Treatment Method
· A professionally designed digital therapy created by clinical psychologists and psychiatrists
· Completely free of charge
Eligibility Criteria
· Hong Kong residents aged 18 to 65 who can speak in Cantonese fluently, read and understand Cantonese
· Experienced sleep disturbances at least 3 nights per week in the past month
· No need for long-term medication for the past four weeks or more.
Receive Rewards for Participating!
Upon completion of all treatment sessions and follow-up assessments, participants will receive up to HKD 500.
How to Join?
Click the link below to register and answer a few simple questions. Our researchers will contact suitable participants to provide further details:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_4UPFh054GtJGXX0
Contact Us
If you have any questions, please call 6115-0322 during office hours to speak with our research assistants.
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

conniehe@link.cuhk.edu.hk

你想了解孩子對於學校或日常生活裡的“領導”的看法嗎？想知道孩子對於“當領導”的意願嗎？不要錯過這次有趣又有意義的研究機會。簡單進行線上研究，還有報酬可領喔~~
招募對象
：
在香港男女共校的小學就讀小1到小6的小學生以及其父親或母親
目前各個組別依舊在積極招募，各個組別依舊席位多多！誠摯邀請合乎要求的小朋友同家長參與~~如果你們身邊有合乎要求的小朋友和家長，也懇請幫我們多多宣傳~~
研究項目：
小學生、家長及老師的領導認知與刻板印象
研究內容（全程以中文進行）：
1.孩子：1對1線上訪談（需錄音），約需1小時。
2.家長：填寫1份網上問卷，約需1小時。
報酬：
家長和孩子完成各自的研究項目後，可獲得共100港幣報酬。
參與條件：
1.兒童參加者為在香港就讀男女共校的小學的小1到小6的小學生，家長參加者為該兒童的父親或母親。
2.兒童能講流利廣東話或普通話，家長能閱讀和書寫中文。
3.兒童可使用有互聯網、視頻和音頻功能的電腦或平板參與研究。
4.兒童沒有主要的身體障礙（如：視障、四肢不健全）和未被診斷有任何有關精神健康或主要的發展障礙的狀況（如：自閉症、過度活躍、讀寫障礙）。
5.請留意參加者需在此前沒有參與過本研究的“預實驗”或“教師部分”（如不清楚是否參與過也可先留下聯繫方式，稍後我們的研究人員將與您聯繫進行確認）。
如對本實驗感興趣，請通過以下鏈接報名
，我們的研究人員將盡快聯繫您：https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_6KzWB6HhTtOhwou
參與純屬自願性質，所收集的資料只作研究用途及保密處理。如有任何疑問，請聯繫何小姐（conniehe@link.cuhk.edu.hk)。

Announcements
How is your year going? Local post-secondary student well-being survey (complete the questionnaire and get a HK$100 voucher) 今年過得怎樣？本地大專生幸福感調查（填問卷攞 HK$100禮券） - JC School of Public Health and Primary Care
From: Melinda Chuchu Liu
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
1155201160@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
生活充實定係空虛？課程有趣但一諗到未來職涯頭都大埋？
親愛的同學們，中大公共衞生及基層醫療學院研究團隊誠邀你參與一項本地大專學生幸福感和心理健康調查。花 15-20 分鐘分享你的幸福感同壓力，完成問卷並通過有效性檢核的受訪者可得 HK$100 惠康 / 屈臣氏 / Marks & Spencer / Sephora禮券或電子禮品卡！不需要高談闊論，只需要你真實的感受。
符合以下
4
個條件即可參與：
18-24 歲的香港永久性居民
本地全日制學士（Degree）或副學位（Asso/HD）課程學生（請在問卷中填寫學生電郵，僅用於資格檢核和發放禮券）
能閱讀和理解繁體中文或英文
能夠使用手機/平板/電腦填寫線上問卷
數據嚴格保密，参与完全自願，可以隨時停止。每位受訪者只能參與和領取酬謝一次。
本調查已獲香港中文大學調查及行為研究操守委員會批准（倫理批准編號：SBRE-23-0714）。如有任何疑問、意見或憂慮，歡迎聯絡研究團隊成員劉楚楚（melindaliucc@link.cuhk.edu.hk）。
問卷連結：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_cBzfQ9gpL3sfQDY?Q_Language=ZH-T
我們希望是次研究能收集到來自不同背景同學的聲音。
如果你身邊有朋友正在副學位課程或其他大專院校（例如：HKUST, LU, HKU SPACE）就讀，我們懇請你將問卷連結分享給他們，讓他們也能分享自己的感受並領取HK$100禮券！
複製
&
轉發：
中大研究團隊依家做緊「本地大專生幸福感與心理健康調查」，填問卷可領 HK$100 禮券（惠康 / 屈臣氏 / Marks & Spencer / Sephora）！
誰可以參與？
18-24 歲嘅香港永久居民 + 本地全日制大專生 + 能閱讀和理解繁體中文或英文問卷 + 能夠使用手機/平板/電腦填寫問卷。
問卷連結：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_cBzfQ9gpL3sfQDY?Q_Language=ZH-T
Is life fulfilling or empty? Finding classes interesting but having a headache for your future career?
Dear students, the research team from the CUHK School of Public Health and Primary Care cordially invites you to participate in a survey on the well-being and mental health of local post-secondary students
Spend 15-20 minutes sharing your feelings and concerns, and receive a HK$100 voucher or e-gift card (choose from Wellcome, Watsons, Marks & Spencer, or Sephora) after completing the online survey and passing the validity check! No fancy words needed—just your most honest feelings.
You are eligible to participate if you meet these 4 criteria:
HK permanent resident aged 18-24
Local full-time undergraduate (Bachelor's Degree) or sub-degree (Associate Degree / Higher Diploma) programme student (please enter your institutional email address in the questionnaire, only for eligibility checking and incentive distribution purposes)
Able to read and understand Traditional Chinese or English
Able to complete the online survey using a smartphone, tablet, or computer
Data is strictly confidential, participation is entirely voluntary, and you can withdraw at any time. Each participant may participate and collect their incentive only once.
This study has been approved by the Survey and Behavioral Research Ethics Committee of The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Ethics Approval Ref. No.: SBRE-23-0714). For any questions, feedback, or concerns, please contact Melinda Chuchu Liu at melindaliucc@link.cuhk.edu.hk.
Survey Link:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_cBzfQ9gpL3sfQDY
We want to make sure that students from diverse backgrounds are represented in this study.
If you have friends studying in sub-degree programmes or at other institutions (e.g., HKUST, LU, HKU SPACE), please share the survey link with them so they can share their feelings and grab a HK$100 voucher too!
Copy & Forward:
The CUHK research team is conducting a survey on the well-being and mental health of local college students. Complete it and grab a HK$100 voucher (choose from Wellcome, Watsons, Marks & Spencer, or Sephora)!
Who can participate?
HK permanent resident aged 18-24 + local full-time undergraduate/sub-degree student + able to read and understand Traditional Chinese or English + able to complete the survey using a smartphone, tablet, or computer.

親愛的同學們，中大公共衞生及基層醫療學院研究團隊誠邀你參與一項本地大專學生幸福感和心理健康調查。花 15-20 分鐘分享你的幸福感同壓力，完成問卷並通過有效性檢核的受訪者可得 HK$100 惠康 / 屈臣氏 / Marks & Spencer / Sephora禮券或電子禮品卡！不需要高談闊論，只需要你真實的感受。
符合以下
4
個條件即可參與：
18-24 歲的香港永久性居民
本地全日制學士（Degree）或副學位（Asso/HD）課程學生（請在問卷中填寫學生電郵，僅用於資格檢核和發放禮券）
能閱讀和理解繁體中文或英文
能夠使用手機/平板/電腦填寫線上問卷
數據嚴格保密，参与完全自願，可以隨時停止。每位受訪者只能參與和領取酬謝一次。
本調查已獲香港中文大學調查及行為研究操守委員會批准（倫理批准編號：SBRE-23-0714）。如有任何疑問、意見或憂慮，歡迎聯絡研究團隊成員劉楚楚（melindaliucc@link.cuhk.edu.hk）。

如果你身邊有朋友正在副學位課程或其他大專院校（例如：HKUST, LU, HKU SPACE）就讀，我們懇請你將問卷連結分享給他們，讓他們也能分享自己的感受並領取HK$100禮券！

&

18-24 歲嘅香港永久居民 + 本地全日制大專生 + 能閱讀和理解繁體中文或英文問卷 + 能夠使用手機/平板/電腦填寫問卷。

https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_cBzfQ9gpL3sfQDY?Q_Language=ZH-T
Is life fulfilling or empty? Finding classes interesting but having a headache for your future career?
Dear students, the research team from the CUHK School of Public Health and Primary Care cordially invites you to participate in a survey on the well-being and mental health of local post-secondary students
Spend 15-20 minutes sharing your feelings and concerns, and receive a HK$100 voucher or e-gift card (choose from Wellcome, Watsons, Marks & Spencer, or Sephora) after completing the online survey and passing the validity check! No fancy words needed—just your most honest feelings.
You are eligible to participate if you meet these 4 criteria:
HK permanent resident aged 18-24
Local full-time undergraduate (Bachelor's Degree) or sub-degree (Associate Degree / Higher Diploma) programme student (please enter your institutional email address in the questionnaire, only for eligibility checking and incentive distribution purposes)
Able to read and understand Traditional Chinese or English
Able to complete the online survey using a smartphone, tablet, or computer
Data is strictly confidential, participation is entirely voluntary, and you can withdraw at any time. Each participant may participate and collect their incentive only once.
This study has been approved by the Survey and Behavioral Research Ethics Committee of The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Ethics Approval Ref. No.: SBRE-23-0714). For any questions, feedback, or concerns, please contact Melinda Chuchu Liu at melindaliucc@link.cuhk.edu.hk.
Survey Link:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_cBzfQ9gpL3sfQDY
We want to make sure that students from diverse backgrounds are represented in this study.
If you have friends studying in sub-degree programmes or at other institutions (e.g., HKUST, LU, HKU SPACE), please share the survey link with them so they can share their feelings and grab a HK$100 voucher too!

The CUHK research team is conducting a survey on the well-being and mental health of local college students. Complete it and grab a HK$100 voucher (choose from Wellcome, Watsons, Marks & Spencer, or Sephora)!
Who can participate?
HK permanent resident aged 18-24 + local full-time undergraduate/sub-degree student + able to read and understand Traditional Chinese or English + able to complete the survey using a smartphone, tablet, or computer.

bodyText:

APPLY NOW!!! MSc in Real Estate Programme (2027 intake)  房地產理學碩士課程（2027 年度入學）現正接受申請！ - MSc in Real Estate Programme Office
From: MSc in Real Estate Programme Office
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
mscre@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

APPLY NOW!!! MSc in Real Estate Programme (2027 intake)

MSc in Real Estate (MRE) is the only master’s degree in Asia that draws on multi-disciplinal research and teaching resources ranging from real estate, business to hospitality.
The programme offers an experiential learning curriculum that integrates theory and real-world practice to ensure that students understand multiple phases of the real estate development from business, investment and community perspectives.
Graduates of our programme will find career opportunities in areas such as development planning, research and consultancy, valuation, real estate finance, investment and management.
The programme is professionally accredited by the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RICS). Graduates are eligible to become chartered surveyors with only 2 years of relevant professional experience, compared with 5 or more years for non-accredited degree holders.
Eligible applicants are automatically considered for Admission Scholarship.
Apply NOW
to secure your place for the 2027 intake!

房地產理學碩士課程（2027 年度入學）現正接受申請！

香港中文大學商學院房地産理學碩士課程是亞洲唯一融合房地産、商業和旅遊資産學科研究和教學資源的碩士課程。
課程結合理論與行業實踐，透過體驗式學習，從商業投資和社區角度教授學生房地産不同發展階段的知識與技能。
課程畢業生職業前景廣闊，包括房地産規劃、開發、融資、投資、估價、資産管理、設施管理、租賃、營銷和諮詢領域等。
課程獲皇家特許測量師學會認証，畢業生於相關領域工作2年後可申請成爲全球認可的注冊測量師（非認証課程畢業生需要最少5年）。
符合條件的申請人將自動獲得入學獎學金資格。
把握2027入學機會，立即申請！

From: Quantitative Finance Programme
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
qfin@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
The IFEC is pleased to share with you the launch of our new education campaign “Investor and Financial Education for All: Don’t Freestyle Your Investments!” / 「投資理財  人人都要識︰投資切忌 Freestyle!」.
According to the IFEC’s “
Retail Investor Study 2025
”, close to 60% of young investors aged 18-29 reported making quick profits through short-term trading was their most important reason for investing. In response, this campaign aims to encourage young people to approach investing with the right mindset and do their research before investing, rather than blindly following the hype.
An energetic animated video has been launched, featuring IFEC Chin Junior and Mr. Chin sharing key investment Dos and Don’ts through an upbeat rap. Audiences are also encouraged to follow IFEC’s
Instagram
and use our comprehensive education resources to make informed investment decisions.
Campaign videos and resources
• Full video version (
Chinese subtitles

)

In addition, this campaign features a
campaign webpage
that offers audiences useful education resources, including articles, online games, and digital tools.

陳果導演作品放映及映後座談｜重溫後九七香港的美麗與哀愁
陳果導演作品放映及映後座談
香港有個荷里活
(2002)
｜
導演：陳果
金像獎導演陳果以超現實色彩交織出一則關於階級、慾望與都市變遷的寓言。導演藉由木屋區與摩天大樓的並置，以黑色幽默與荒誕現實主義的筆觸，書寫後九七時期香港的集體焦慮。
是次活動將先放映全片，映後特別邀請導演陳果親臨現場，圍繞獨立電影精神、社會地景與角色塑造等展開深度對談，並設現場 Q&A 環節。
二十餘載閃逝，大磡村早已消失。重溫這部作品，讓我們可以探討城市重組、邊緣命運與身份認同的演變。誠邀各位一同蒞臨，重新審視香港。
電影榮獲第39屆金馬獎最佳導演、最佳造型設計及最佳音效；以及第9屆香港電影評論學會大獎最佳編劇與推薦電影。
日期：2026年11月17日（星期二）
時間：7:00 - 9:00 pm（放映）｜晚上 9:00 - 9:30 pm（映後座談及問答環節）
地點：康本國際學術園一號演講廳（YIA LT-1）
放映作品：香港有個荷里活（2002年，108分鐘，中文字幕）
座談嘉賓：陳果導演
對象：中大學生及教職員、校友及公眾人士
費用：免費參加，先到先得
即時報名：
報名《香港有個荷里活》電影放映及座談
合辦單位：
山城影院 (OSA)
自學中心 (ILC)
書寫力量
中大電影學會

Film Screening & Q&A with Director Fruit Chan｜Revisiting the Melancholy and Beauty of Post-97 Hong Kong

Director Fruit Chan Film Screening & Post-Screening Q&A
Hollywood Hong Kong (2002) | Directed by Fruit Chan
Award-winning director Fruit Chan uses surrealist elements to craft a dark fable about class, desire, and urban transformation. By contrasting a squatter village with neighboring luxury skyscrapers, the film employs dark humor and absurd realism to capture the collective anxiety of post-1997 Hong Kong.
The event will begin with a full screening of the film, followed by an in-depth conversation with Director Fruit Chan himself. He will share his insights on the spirit of independent filmmaking, social landscapes, and character development, followed by a Q&A session.
More than two decades have flown by, and Dai Hom Village has long since vanished. Revisiting this masterpiece allows us to explore urban redevelopment, marginalization, and the evolution of cultural identity. We invite you to join us and rediscover Hong Kong through his lens.
Hollywood Hong Kong
won Best Director, Best Makeup & Costume Design, and Best Sound Effects at the 39th Golden Horse Awards. It was also awarded Best Screenplay and named a Recommended Film at the 9th Hong Kong Film Critics Society Awards.
Event Details
Date: November 17, 2026, Tue
Time: 7:00 PM - 9:00 PM (Screening), 9:00 PM - 9:30 PM (Post-screening Talk & Q&A)
Venue: Yasumoto International Academic Park, Lecture Theatre 1 (YIA LT-1)
Screening Title: Hollywood Hong Kong (2002, 108 mins, with Chinese subtitles)
Guest Speaker: Film Director Fruit Chan
Target Audience: CUHK students, staff, alumni, and the public
Admission: Free (First-come, first-served)

We are now inviting Hong Kong young adults to participate in a bereavement survey, titled “Trajectories of grief outcomes and the associated psychosocial predictors among recently bereaved young adults in Hong Kong: A retrospective longitudinal mixed-methods approach”. Participants will receive up to HK$300 coupons upon completion.
Participant Inclusion Criteria:
Local young adults aged 18 to 29 residing in Hong Kong.
Have experienced the death of a close friend/relative or an important person within the past 18 months.
Able to read Chinese and communicate in Cantonese.
1) Baseline Questionnaire
- After signing the consent form, participants will complete a 20-minute baseline questionnaire.
- The questionnaire will include questions about grieving process in response to the death of a loved one or significant person, and attitudes toward death
- Participants will receive HK$100 coupons for completing the baseline questionnaire.
2) First Follow-up Questionnaire
- Six months later, participants who have completed the baseline questionnaire will be invited to complete a follow-up questionnaire.
- Participants who complete the first follow-up questionnaire will be rewarded with HK$100 coupons.
3) Second Follow-up Questionnaire
- Six months after the first follow-up questionnaire, participants who have completed the first follow-up questionnaire will be invited to complete a second follow-up questionnaire.
- Participants who complete the second follow-up questionnaire after will be rewarded with HK$100 coupons.
Participation in this study is voluntary. The study data will be kept confidential and no one other than the researchers will have access to the questionnaire information or audio recordings completed by the participants. This study has been approved by The Joint CUHK-NTEC CREC (CREC-2025.748) and the Survey and Behavioral Research Ethics Committee of the Chinese University of Hong Kong (SBRE‐24‐0378).
Please use the following link to fill out the consent form and questionnaire. Upon completion, you will be rewarded with HK$100 coupons.
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_4SbSwIIE6shc67I
You are welcome to recommend this recruitment information to qualified young adults in Hong Kong.
For enquiries, please contact Dr. Ling
E-mail: haofengling@cuhk.edu.hk

Announcements
“In Dialogue with China” Study Trip to Ganzhou (Deadline Extension) 「訪談中國」贛州研學團（延長報名截止日期） - Office of University General Education
From: General Education China Programme, Office of University General Education
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ugcp@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Dear students,
The application deadline for the “In Dialogue with China” Study Trip to Ganzhou, Jiangxi, has been extended to
1 November 2026
.
The Long March of the Chinese Red Army from the Central Soviet Area in Jiangxi to northern Shaanxi between 1934 and 1936, a journey of 12,500 km, was a great human epic that changed the course of Chinese history. The renowned American journalist Harrison Salisbury, who retraced the route of the Long March in 1983 and wrote The Long March: The Untold Story, called it “the crucible of the Chinese revolution.” The Long March has no parallel in human history, and “its heroism has fired the dreams of a nation of 1.1 billion people.”
This study trip will explore the history of the Red Army’s Jiangxi Soviet Area and visit the departure point of the Red Army’s Long March. It will also visit Gannan Normal University for exchanges with its faculty and students and examine how the Ganzhou region fosters community governance and rural revitalization in the new Long March of Chinese modernization.
The details of the study trip are as follows:
Theme
Ganzhou: Long March and Chinese Modernization
Period
26-29 December 2026 (4 days)
Tentative Itinerary
Jiangxi Soviet Area in Ruijin (瑞金中央蘇區); Site of the First National Congress of the Chinese Soviet Republic (中華蘇維埃共和國第一次全國代表大會舊址); Shazhouba Revolutionary Sites (沙洲壩革命舊址); Memorial Hall of the Departure Point of the Central Red Army’s Long March (中央紅軍長征出發地紀念館); Red Army Long March Trail (紅軍長征小道); Gannan Normal University (贛南師範大學); Fushougou Museum (福壽溝博物館); and Former Residence of Chiang Ching-kuo (蔣經國舊居), etc.
Quota
20 CUHK undergraduate students
Language Requirements
Cantonese and Putonghua
Programme Fee
HK$500
Application Deadline
1 November 2026
Online Registration
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13744977
Remarks:
A deposit of HK$4,000 is required, which will be refunded to students who have completed the whole trip and all other related activities and requirements after deducting the programme fee.
Participants are required to read relevant articles, attend a briefing session before departure, present individual reflections in a post-trip sharing session, and submit a written report of at least 1000 words in English or 1000 characters in Chinese after the trip.
Participants should possess valid travel documents to China.
Should you have any queries, please feel free to contact the General Education China Programme of the Office of University General Education at 3943 0595 or write to
ugcp@cuhk.edu.hk
.
各位同學：
「訪談中國」贛州研學之旅的報名截止日期已延長至
2026
年
11
月
1
日
。
中國紅軍1934-1936從江西中央蘇區轉移到陝北的二萬五千里長征，是人類歷史上的一篇史詩，改變了中國的歷史。美國著名記者索爾茲伯1983年重游長征路而寫成《長征：前所未聞的故事》，說長征是舉世無雙的，它是「中國革命的熔爐」，「所表現的英雄主義激勵著一個有十一億人口的民族」。
這次研學團，將學習紅軍中央蘇區歷史，參觀紅軍長征出發地，與贛南師範大學師生交流，並考察贛州地區在中國式現代化的新長征過程中如何進行社區治理與鄉村振興。
研學團的詳情如下：
主題
贛州：長征與中國式現代化
日期
2026年12月26至29日
目的地
贛州
行程
瑞金中央蘇區；中華蘇維埃共和國第一次全國代表大會舊址；沙洲壩革命舊址；中央紅軍長征出發地紀念館；紅軍長征小道；贛南師範大學；福壽溝博物館；蔣經國舊居
名額
20名中大本科生
語言要求
粵語和普通話
費用
$500
報名截止日期
2026年11月1日
網上報名連結
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13744977
備註：
(i)        參加者須繳付按金$4,000，完成所有行程和項目相關活動及要求後，將獲退還扣除活動費用的餘額。
(ii)       參加者須閱讀相關文章，出發前參加說明會，並在完成研學行程後參加分享會，作個人報告及提交一份以英文或中文書寫不少於1000字的報告。
(iii)       參加者須持有前往中國內地的有效旅遊證件。
如有查詢，請電郵至ugcp@cuhk.edu.hk，或致電3943 0595 聯絡大學通識教育部通識中國課程。
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

/weekly/

歡迎轉發予可能感興趣的親友。
The Department of Surgery, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, invites eligible individuals to join the “Aspirin Colon” Study.
Study Purpose
To investigate whether aspirin increases the risk of bleeding after polyp removal.
To evaluate the cardiovascular impact of temporarily stopping aspirin.
Eligibility
Aged 45 or above.
Currently taking aspirin for heart, cerebrovascular, or vascular disease.
Not taking any other antiplatelet medications.
Have not undergone a colonoscopy within the past 2 years.
What Participation Involves
You will be scheduled for a colonoscopy in the coming months.
You will be randomly assigned to one of the following groups.
Aspirin (80 mg) or placebo (a medication-free control).
Take the assigned study tablet once daily for 5 days before colonoscopy and for 3 days after polyp removal.
Contact Us Now for Details or Enrolment
Phone: 3505-2640
WhatsApp: 5589 6364
(Research Assistant: Ms. Chan)

Let's listen to some music!! Recruiting Young Music Lovers | AI and Popular Song Emotion 一齊聽歌! 招募音樂愛好青年｜人工智能與流行歌曲情緒分類研究 - Department of Psychiatry
From: Xiuyang Meng
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
mastersleep@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
招募音樂愛好青年｜人工智能與流行歌曲情緒分類研究
我們正在尋找熱愛音樂的你，參與人工智能與流行歌曲情緒分類研究，用你的聽感為 AI 模型注入真實的青年情緒視角。
研究目的
本研究旨在運用人工智能技術，從青年視角對粵語流行歌曲進行情緒分類標註，評估青年群體對音樂情緒的主觀感知特徵，並為個性化音樂推薦系統及情緒調節相關研究提供數據支持。
招募條件
18 至 24 歲，熱愛音樂且經常聆聽流行音樂，能流暢使用粵語及英語進行溝通與表達的青年。
參與內容
聆聽 50 首粵語流行歌曲，並完整聽畢每首參與標註的曲目，依據自身主觀體驗與即時情緒感受，將歌曲進行情緒分類。
如何加入？
請點擊以下連結進行註冊，並回答幾條簡單問題。研究員將聯絡適合的參加者，詳細解釋研究內容：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_5pU67FrIxYilalw
聯絡我們
如有任何疑問，請於辦公時間內致電 6115-0322 與研究助理陳小姐 或 蒙先生聯絡。
Recruiting Young Music Lovers | AI and Popular Song Emotion Categorization Research
We are looking for music lovers like you to participate in our research on AI and popular song emotion categorization, contributing your listening experience to inject authentic youth emotional perspectives into our AI model.
Purpose of the Study
This study aims to use artificial intelligence technology to annotate the emotion categories of Cantopop songs from a youth perspective, evaluate the subjective emotional perception characteristics of young people towards music, and provide data support for personalized music recommendation systems and emotion regulation-related research.
Eligibility Criteria
Young people aged 18 to 24 who love music, listen to popular music regularly, and are able to communicate fluently in Cantonese and English.
Participation Content
Listen to 50 Cantopop songs in full and categorize each song according to your subjective experience and immediate emotional feelings.
How to Join?
Please click the link below to register and answer a few simple questions. Our researchers will contact eligible participants to explain the study details in full:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_5pU67FrIxYilalw
Contact Us
If you have any questions, please call 6115-0322 during office hours to speak with our research assistants Ms. Chan or Mr. Meng.

bodyText:

Announcements
Recruitment of student interns for a community health research project 招募社區健康研究項目實習生 - JC School of Public Health and Primary Care
From: Edwin Chung
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
shunkitchung@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港中文大學賽馬會公共衛生及基層醫療學院研究團隊現正進行一項
社區研究。本計劃透過免費提供空氣清新機，幫助居住在空氣質素欠佳環境
的 6 至 17 歲哮喘兒童及青少年改善居住環境。
我們誠邀中大本科生加入參與實習，
一同走進社區，透過科學方法協助家庭。
工作範疇
- 研究期間：即日起至 2027 年 10 月 31 日（按團隊編排彈性參與）
- 協助研究團隊在指定的日期和地點進行研究對象招募。
- 按日子到研究對象的住所設置空氣監測儀器、放置空氣清新機，並為研究對象進行呼吸測試。
- 執行研究團隊指派的其他工作。
招募條件
- 現正就讀大學學士學位課程的學生（醫學、護理、公共衛生或相關課
程更佳）。
- 具備良好溝通技巧，能操流利廣東話（具適量普通話水平更佳）。
- 熟悉基本電腦應用。
報名方式
如有興趣參與本研究實習，請將個人履歷傳送至電郵：jchomes@cuhk.edu.hk
（郵件標題請註明：申請哮喘兒童研究學生實習)
聯絡及查詢
香港中文大學賽馬會公共衛生及基層醫療學院
負責同事: Sang/Edwin
電話：(852) 2252 8744
電郵：jchomes@cuhk.edu.hk
The research team from the Jockey Club School of Public Health and Primary Care at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) is currently conducting a community study. This project aims to improve the living conditions of children and adolescents aged 6 to 17 with asthma who reside in poor air quality environments by providing them with free air purifiers.
We sincerely invite CUHK undergraduate students to join us as interns to step into the community and assist these families through scientific methods.
Scope of Work
Research Period: From now until October 31, 2027 (flexible participation based on the team's schedule)
Participant Recruitment: Assist the research team in recruiting study subjects at designated dates and locations.
Home Visits & Testing: Visit the subjects' homes to set up air monitoring equipment, place air purifiers, and conduct respiratory tests for the subjects.
Other Duties: Execute other tasks assigned by the research team.
Recruitment Criteria
Education: Current undergraduate students pursuing a bachelor's degree (preferably in Medicine, Nursing, Public Health, or related programs).
Languages: Good communication skills, fluent in Cantonese (proficiency in Mandarin is a plus).
Skills: Familiar with basic computer applications.
Application Method
If you are interested in participating in this research internship, please send your resume to jchomes@cuhk.edu.hk (Please use the subject line: Application for Pediatric Asthma Study Student Internship).
Contact and Inquiries
Jockey Club School of Public Health and Primary Care, CUHK
Contact Persons: Sang / Edwin
Phone: (852) 2252 8744
Email: jchomes@cuhk.edu.hk

For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

程更佳）。

如有興趣參與本研究實習，請將個人履歷傳送至電郵：jchomes@cuhk.edu.hk

香港中文大學賽馬會公共衛生及基層醫療學院

The research team from the Jockey Club School of Public Health and Primary Care at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) is currently conducting a community study. This project aims to improve the living conditions of children and adolescents aged 6 to 17 with asthma who reside in poor air quality environments by providing them with free air purifiers.
We sincerely invite CUHK undergraduate students to join us as interns to step into the community and assist these families through scientific methods.
Scope of Work
Research Period: From now until October 31, 2027 (flexible participation based on the team's schedule)
Participant Recruitment: Assist the research team in recruiting study subjects at designated dates and locations.
Home Visits & Testing: Visit the subjects' homes to set up air monitoring equipment, place air purifiers, and conduct respiratory tests for the subjects.
Other Duties: Execute other tasks assigned by the research team.
Recruitment Criteria
Education: Current undergraduate students pursuing a bachelor's degree (preferably in Medicine, Nursing, Public Health, or related programs).
Languages: Good communication skills, fluent in Cantonese (proficiency in Mandarin is a plus).
Skills: Familiar with basic computer applications.

To develop a reading ability assessment scale tailored for native Chinese speakers.

From: MPhil and PhD Programmes in Public Health Enquiry

CUHK PhD in Public Health
香港中文大學
公共衛生哲學博士課程
The Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS) is a government initiative to support outstanding students from around the world (including local HK) to study in Hong Kong. For Intake 2027-28, the academic year starts on 1 August 2027.
We invite excellent students to apply for CUHK PhD programme in Public Health and welcome students to apply for HKPFS. These provide opportunities to study full-time with financial support in Hong Kong.
Please note that both application deadlines are on December 1, 2026.
Our research themes include:
•          Non-communicable disease and aging, and Family Medicine & Primary Healthcare
•          Environmental health and infectious diseases
•          Global health policy, health system & healthcare delivery
•          Mental well-being, social & health behaviours
•          Bioinformatics, machine learning and big data
CUHK HKPFS offers:
- HKPFS stipend at HK$344,400 (approx. US$44,200) per year; Up to HK$1.38 Million (approx. US$176,620)
- Conference and Research-related Travel Allowance is HK$14,400 (approx. US$1,850) per year; Up to HK$87,600 (approx. US$11,230)
- And CUHK Vice-Chancellor HKPFS Scholarship - an award of total HK$80,000 (approx. US$10,260)
- Tuition Fee Waiver - Up to HK$198,0000 (approx. US$25,390)
- Lodging Award - Up to HK$100,000 (approx. US$12,820)
- 1st Year Accommodation Fee Waiver and Guaranteed On-campus Accommodation
Step 1: To submit an initial application to RGC. Application deadline: 1 Dec 2026 at 12:00 noon (GMT+8, Hong Kong Time); and
Step 2: To submit full application to CUHK. Application deadline: 1 Dec 2026 at 11:59pm (GMT+8, Hong Kong Time).
Details of MPhil-PhD programme in Public Health can be found on webpage
https://www.gs.cuhk.edu.hk/admissions/programme/medicine#mphil-phd-in-public-health
or
https://sphpc.cuhk.edu.hk/rpg-programme/
For more info about our School’s Research Themes and list of on-going grants, please refer to webpage
https://sphpc.cuhk.edu.hk/research-themes/
You can find the scholarship information at

You may also refer to the "FAQs" Section at
https://www.gs.cuhk.edu.hk/admissions/faqs
for more information.

Announcements
[Student Helper Recruitment] Chinese Language and Culture Experience Activities | Cross-cultural Exchange  - Yale-China Chinese Language Academy
From: Yale-China Chinese Language Academy
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
CLA_UPD@CUHK.EDU.HK
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
【學生助理招募】中國語言文化體驗活動｜跨文化交流
雅禮中國語文研習所將於本學期舉辦一系列面向國際學生的中國語言文化體驗活動，主題涵蓋漢字與書法、傳統節慶、手工文化體驗、中文詩歌與文化分享。現誠邀中大學生擔任學生助理，協助活動籌備與現場支援。
活動時間：逢星期五下午，每次兩小時，預計本學期共舉辦5至6次
活動地點：方潤華堂（東鐵線大學站D出口對面）
申請條件：
對跨文化交流充滿熱情，性格開朗，有親和力，具備良好英語溝通能力，並能說標準普通話或粵語；
具備與中華文化相關的才藝，如中國結、詩歌賞析，並樂意與國際學生交流分享；
會編製不同類型的中國結，了解中國結的歷史和種類；
對古詩詞有較為深入的認識，能簡單講解詩詞背景與含義；
懂得古詩詞的押韻、平仄，能簡單從音樂角度賞析詩詞；
會做手工，如拓印、剪紙等的學生獲優先考慮。
待遇：時薪 HKD$67 + 5% MPF
總工作時數：約15小時
有意者請於11月13日前填妥以下表格，合則約見：

報名表格
如有疑問，請聯絡陳小姐：
liyuanchen@cuhk.edu.hk
[Student Helper Recruitment] Chinese Language and Culture Experience Activities | Cross-cultural Exchange]
The Yale-China Chinese Language Academy will host a series of cultural workshops this semester for international students, focusing on themes in Chinese language and culture, including Chinese characters, calligraphy, traditional festivals, handicrafts, poetry, songs, and cultural sharing. We are now recruiting CUHK students to assist with planning and running these events.
Schedule: Friday afternoons, 2 hours per session, approximately 5–6 sessions throughout the semester
Venue: Fong Yun Wah Hall (opposite University Station Exit D)
Requirements:
Passionate about cross-cultural communication, outgoing, friendly, fluent in English, and able to speak Putonghua or Cantonese;
Possess talents or skills related to Chinese culture and be willing to share and interact with international students;
Capable of making Chinese knots and familiar with the history and different types of Chinese knots;
Familiar with classical Chinese poetry and songs and be able to explain the background and meaning;
Understand the rhyme and tone patterns of classical poetry, and be able to offer simple appreciation of poems from a musical perspective;
Priority will be given to students with skills in handicraft such as Chinese rubbing and paper cutting.
Compensation: HKD$67/hr + 5% MPF
Total working hours: Around 15 hours
Interested applicants should complete the form below by November 13. Interviews will be arranged for shortlisted candidates:

Application Form
For inquiries, please contact Miss Chen at
liyuanchen@cuhk.edu.hk
View Count

https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

The Yale-China Chinese Language Academy will host a series of cultural workshops this semester for international students, focusing on themes in Chinese language and culture, including Chinese characters, calligraphy, traditional festivals, handicrafts, poetry, songs, and cultural sharing. We are now recruiting CUHK students to assist with planning and running these events.
Schedule: Friday afternoons, 2 hours per session, approximately 5–6 sessions throughout the semester
Venue: Fong Yun Wah Hall (opposite University Station Exit D)
Requirements:
Passionate about cross-cultural communication, outgoing, friendly, fluent in English, and able to speak Putonghua or Cantonese;
Possess talents or skills related to Chinese culture and be willing to share and interact with international students;
Capable of making Chinese knots and familiar with the history and different types of Chinese knots;
Familiar with classical Chinese poetry and songs and be able to explain the background and meaning;
Understand the rhyme and tone patterns of classical poetry, and be able to offer simple appreciation of poems from a musical perspective;
Priority will be given to students with skills in handicraft such as Chinese rubbing and paper cutting.
Compensation: HKD$67/hr + 5% MPF
Total working hours: Around 15 hours
Interested applicants should complete the form below by November 13. Interviews will be arranged for shortlisted candidates:

Application Form
For inquiries, please contact Miss Chen at
liyuanchen@cuhk.edu.hk
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

Introduce the relationship between language and culture

Announcements
Recruitment of participants aged 6-80 years old with LONG COVID 誠邀 6-80 歲有長新冠症狀的患者參加「中醫/西醫治療長新冠症狀」的研究  - Hong Kong Institute of Integrative Medicine
From: Wendy LI
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
hkiimresearch@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港中文大學香港中西醫結合醫學研究所現正進行一項為期8周，以內服中藥(沖劑)或西藥改善長新冠患者症狀的臨床研究，以下是研究安排：
研究對象：
年齡介乎6至80歲；
願意接受中醫或西醫治療4星期；
每星期一次覆診跟進病程；
目的         : 比較中藥與西藥對治療長新冠患者在改善生活質量、臨床症狀和生活社等治療效果和安全性。
研究內容：中/西醫評估*、問卷評估、抽血檢查、服用中藥或西藥等。
*注意: 本研究會隨機分「中藥組」或「西藥組」
研究地點： (a)中藥組: 沙田威爾斯親王醫院; (b)西藥組: 指定西醫診所 (中環)。
參與方式： 若有興趣，歡迎
1.透過以下方式報名：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13670048
2.亦歡迎您致電或WhatsApp我們6082-2583/ 2873-3245了解詳情。
Research Introduction:
The novel coronavirus has caused a global pandemic since the end of 2019. People are increasingly paying attention to the long-term effects of COVID-19 infection.People whose symptoms last for more than four weeks after COVID-19 infection are called [Long COVID]. The main symptoms include severe fatigue, shortness of breath, heart damage (such as myocarditis), cognitive impairment, sleep disorders, post-traumatic stress disorder syndrome, Muscle pain, decreased concentration, headache, impaired taste and smell, etc. affect the respiratory system, cardiovascular system, digestive system, urinary system, immune system, etc.
The Hong Kong Institute of Integrated Traditional Chinese and Western Medicine at the Chinese University of Hong Kong is currently conducting an 8-week clinical study on the improvement of symptoms of patients with COVID-19 by taking Chinese medicine (infusion) or Western medicine.
Target
: Age 6-80 who have recovered from COVID-19 infection.
Purpose
: To compare the therapeutic effects and safety of traditional Chinese medicine and Western medicine on improving the quality of life, clinical symptoms and social functions of long-term COVID-19 patients.
Research Content
: Visits, questionnaire assessment, blood draw before and after taking medicine,taking research Chinese medicine or Western medicine, etc.
Study Location
:(a) Chinese medicine group: Prince of Wales Hospital, Shatin;
(b) Western medicine group: designated western medicine clinic.
Participation
： Free of charge. If interested, please
1. sign up through the following ：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13670048
2. You are also welcome to call or WhatsApp us at 6082-2583/ 2873-3245 for details.
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

[Recruitment]
HCC: Historical and Cultural Innovation Experience Tour in Shekou
Have you ever wondered how Shekou evolved from a fishing village into a major trading port, and how its cultural heritage is being transformed into products and commercial ventures?
Join us on the Historical and Cultural Innovation Experience Tour in Shekou, organised by the Heritage and Cultural Conservation Ambassador Programme (HCC)! You will explore Shekou’s development history, local life, and cultural innovation and entrepreneurship projects. Participants can also choose their own theme for in-depth exploration.
Departure Dates
Phase 1: 28 – 29 November 2026 (2 days 1 night)
Phase 2: 4 – 6 January 2027 (3 days 2 nights)
Programme Schedule
Interview: 9 November 2026 (Monday) or 11 November 2026 (Wednesday)
Briefing Session: 23 November 2026, 7:00 – 9:00 pm
Eligibility
All CUHK undergraduate students
Able to communicate in Cantonese and Putonghua
Interested in history, cultural innovation, and entrepreneurship
Willing to work collaboratively in a team
Quota
5 places (selected through interview)
Fees & Subsidy
Activity deposit: HK$100
Activity fee: approximately HK$1,300
(Participants who complete the full programme will receive an HK$800 subsidy and a full refund of the deposit)
Transportation, accommodation, meals, and personal expenses are to be borne by participants
Activity Details
Click here for details
Registration
Register now
Application Deadline
6 November 2026 (12:00 noon)
Places are limited — register now! Discover how history and culture can find new opportunities in modern development.
Follow the Heritage and Cultural Conservation Ambassador on Instagram / Threads
@cuhk_hcc2627
for more exciting activities and highlights.
For enquiries, please get in touch with Vicky (1155258804@link.cuhk.edu.hk).
【招募】HCC：蛇口歷史文化創新體驗之旅
你想知道蛇口如何從漁村變成貿易港口，又如何把文化元素轉化成產品和商業項目嗎？
快來參加我們古蹟與文化保育大使計劃（HCC）的「蛇口歷史文化創新體驗之旅」！你將了解蛇口的發展歷史、當地生活，以及文化創新與創業項目，還可以自行訂立主題深入探索！
出發日期
第一階段: 2026 年 11 月 28 – 29日（兩日一夜）
第二階段: 2027 年 1 月 4 – 6 日（三日兩夜）

中大全日制本科生;

[Recruitment]
HCC: Historical and Cultural Innovation Experience Tour in Shekou
Have you ever wondered how Shekou evolved from a fishing village into a major trading port, and how its cultural heritage is being transformed into products and commercial ventures?
Join us on the Historical and Cultural Innovation Experience Tour in Shekou, organised by the Heritage and Cultural Conservation Ambassador Programme (HCC)! You will explore Shekou’s development history, local life, and cultural innovation and entrepreneurship projects. Participants can also choose their own theme for in-depth exploration.
Departure Dates
Phase 1: 28 – 29 November 2026 (2 days 1 night)
Phase 2: 4 – 6 January 2027 (3 days 2 nights)
Programme Schedule
Interview: 9 November 2026 (Monday) or 11 November 2026 (Wednesday)
Briefing Session: 23 November 2026, 7:00 – 9:00 pm
Eligibility
All CUHK undergraduate students
Able to communicate in Cantonese and Putonghua
Interested in history, cultural innovation, and entrepreneurship
Willing to work collaboratively in a team
Quota
5 places (selected through interview)
Fees & Subsidy
Activity deposit: HK$100
Activity fee: approximately HK$1,300
(Participants who complete the full programme will receive an HK$800 subsidy and a full refund of the deposit)
Transportation, accommodation, meals, and personal expenses are to be borne by participants
Activity Details
Click here for details

Register now

6 November 2026 (12:00 noon)
Places are limited — register now! Discover how history and culture can find new opportunities in modern development.

@cuhk_hcc2627
for more exciting activities and highlights.

Invitation to the HKEAA Research Forum on Assessment and STEM Education 誠邀參加香港考試及評核局研究論壇 - EdDataX Research Centre
From: Angus NG
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
angusmingho@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Dear Colleagues and Students,
Greetings from the EdDataX Research Centre, CUHK
As part of our ongoing collaboration with the Hong Kong Examinations and Assessment Authority (HKEAA) on international large-scale assessment projects, we are pleased to invite you to attend the upcoming HKEAA Research Forum.
Date:
5 November 2026 (Thursday)
Time:
9:30 a.m. – 4:30 p.m.
Venue:
HKEAA Hung Hom Office and Examination Centre
The forum will feature distinguished scholars and practitioners sharing insights on educational assessment, STEM education, and emerging developments in the age of artificial intelligence.
This forum offers an excellent opportunity for academics, researchers, teachers, and students to learn more about international large-scale assessments, current educational research, and the future of learning and assessment.
You and your colleagues are cordially invited to attend.
Registration:
https://www.hkeaa.edu.hk/en/events/registration.html
We look forward to your participation.
Kind regards,
EdDataX Research Centre
The Chinese University of Hong Kong
各位同事及同學：
您好！
教育數據研究中心一直與香港考試及評核局（HKEAA）合作推展多項國際大型教育評估研究項目。現誠邀各位參加由考評局舉辦的研究論壇，了解教育評估、STEM 教育及人工智能時代下的最新發展。
日期：
2026年11月5日（星期四）
時間：
上午9時30分至下午4時30分
地點：
考評局紅磡辦事處及考試中心
論壇將邀請多位學者及專家分享教育評估及 STEM 教育的最新研究與實踐經驗。
是次論壇為對教育研究、教育評估、人工智能、學習科學及 STEM 教育有興趣的教職員及同學提供寶貴的學習和交流機會，同時亦有助加深了解 TIMSS 等國際大型教育評估研究的最新發展。
誠邀各位老師、研究人員及同學踴躍參加。
報名連結：
https://www.hkeaa.edu.hk/en/events/registration.html
期待與大家在論壇見面！

https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

The Independent Learning Centre (ILC) offers a wide range of workshops and activities to support learning of language and communication skills. Visit our website for more information: http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ (20261102)  - ILC
From: ILC
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ilc-counsel@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
【Weekly Highlights - English Section 】
A. Communication, Study Skills and Job Preparation Workshops
The Independent Learning Centre offers English workshops 2 November to 6 November: (1) Ace Your Oral Presentations, (2) Job Preparation Series: Writing Impressive Application Letters, (3) Hong Kong Civil Service Interview Preparation, and (4) Global Citizenship Series: Sustainable Consumption. These workshops are now available for registration at: http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/workshops.aspx
B. Consultation Service in English
Consultation service is available during the following time:
2 November (Mon): 10:30 – 12:30
3 November (Tue): 10:30 – 12:30
4 November (Wed): 10:30 – 12:30
5 November (Thu): 14:30 – 16:30
Online Booking:
https://ilccuhk.as.me/schedule.php
More Timeslot please check our website：
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EH/consultation.aspx
====================================
【Weekly Highlights - Chinese Section 】中文部本週活動
A. Chinese Workshops 中文工作坊
The Independent Learning Centre offers Chinese workshops 2 November to 6 November: (1) JRE Argumentative Writing I, (2) CV & Cover Letter Writing (Cantonese), and (3) Happy Hour. These workshops are now available for registration at: https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/CH/workshops.aspx
自學中心十一月二日至十一月六日舉辦 (1) JRE 議論文寫作 (一), (2) 「天下之能事畢矣」—— 《易經》占筮入門 (粵), (3) 中文求職信及履歷寫作(粵), 及 (4) Happy Hour @ 逐粒字，執字粒：淺談活字印刷等工作坊，歡迎報名。
登記連結： https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/CH/workshops.aspx
B. Consultation Service in Chinese 自學中心中文輔導服務
Consultation service is available during the following time:
自學中心於十一月二日至十一月六日提供以下中文輔導時段。
2 November (Mon): 10:30 – 12:30
3 November (Tue): 14:30 – 16:30
4 November (Wed): 10:30 – 12:30
5 November (Thu): 10:30 – 12:30 and 14:30 – 16:30
網上預約：
https://ilccuhk.as.me/schedule.php
更多中文輔導時段。
====================================
C. “The Power of Words” 「書寫力量」
This is a reading and writing event organized by the ILC, Hong Kong Literature Research Centre, the Office of Arts Administrator (OAA) and Tolopoem. Activities we have this semester include Blackboard / Glass Wall Poems, Talks of Dialogue in the Arts and Workshops.
自學中心、香港文學研究中心、藝術行政主任辦公室及吐露詩社合辦的大型閱讀及寫作活動。這個學期的活動，除黑板詩及玻璃詩外，還有藝文縱談及各式工作坊。各項活動的資料可以參看：https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/CH/Event/thepowerofwords.aspx
====================================
【Independent Online Learning Resources】自學中心網上自學資源
A. Independent Online Learning Resources in English
- Academic Writing
Visit this link on academic writing skills and convention for different citation styles:
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ENResources/Writing_Writing.aspx
- Vocabulary
Visit this link for both General Vocabulary and Specific Vocabulary (e.g. For Business and Medical Professionals) lists and practices:
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ENResources/Writing_Vocab.aspx
- Job Search and Interviews
Visit this link to identify your capabilities and personality types, learn how to prepare job search documents and personal statements, and how to get ready for job interviews:
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ENResources/JobSearching.aspx
B. Independent Online Learning Resources in Chinese中文網上自學材料
- Academic Writing論文寫作
Visit this link for advice on academic writing, with highlights on structure, expressions, common grammatical mistakes, etc.
針對大學生撰寫學術論文時所遇到的困難，提供實用的知識和練習。內容包括：學期論文的結構與寫作步驟、常見語法錯誤、表達與語言邏輯等，歡迎使用：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/AWOnline/general1.html
- ‘Pulewang’ Online Putonghua Platform「普樂網」網上普通話平台
An online Putonghua learning platform designed for CU students. Essential knowledge of Putonghua is introduced with interactive exercises and games. Extended conversational exchanges on selected topics of social affairs and student life are available for oral practice with texts and pinyin.
針對本校同學學習需要的網上普通話平台，內容圍繞大學生的學習與日常生活，設計深入淺出，每單元均有練習與遊戲，互動有趣，歡迎使用：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/Chinese/plw/index.html
- Argumentative Writing議論文寫作
Visit this link for advice on the structure, the content and the language of argumentative writing.
介紹議論文的結構及寫作要求，以解說、例子及練習，呈現寫作議論時要注意的內容及語言特點：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/arguWriting/001.html
- Cantonese Pronunciation粵語拼音速遞
This guide is designed for mainland students as an effective way to learn Cantonese pronunciation. Basic knowledge of Cantonese syllables is introduced with exercises. Comparison of Cantonese and Putonghua pronunciation is also highlighted
協助內地同學迅速掌握粵語發音。內容包括：語音基礎、粵普對比、難點練習等，歡迎使用：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/cantontones/_home/index.html
- Cantonese Express港式粵語速遞
An interactive introduction to Hong Kong style Cantonese. Daily expressions and situational conversations are introduced with interactive exercises.
以有趣互動的方式介紹港式粵語，包括日常生活用語、情景會話、互動練習等，歡迎使用：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/canton_express/others/frontpage.html
- Online Cantonese for Foreigners
A free online platform for international students to learn basic Cantonese. The texts are clear and simple, and interactive exercises easy to use: http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/can_eng/layout.html
- Online Putonghua for Foreigners
Do you know how to make orders in a Chinese restaurant and learn how to bargain when you travel in China? Here are some situational conversations and basic knowledge of Putonghua to learn online: https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/CHResources/Lang_PTH_EnglishSpk.aspx

From: Yale-China Chinese Language Academy

CLA_UPD@CUHK.EDU.HK
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Minor Programmes in Chinese Language (Cantonese/Putonghua) as a Second Language
Jointly with the Department of Linguistics and Modern Languages (LING), CLA is pleased to announce that two minor programmes are offered to CUHK students whose native language is not Putonghua or Cantonese admitted in 2022-23 and thereafter:
Minor Programme in Chinese Language (Cantonese) as a Second Language
Minor Programme in Chinese Language (Putonghua) as a Second Language
In each programme, students are required to complete a minimum of 21 units of courses, including 2 courses offered by LING and 5 Cantonese/Putonghua courses offered by CLA.
The minor programmes aim to provide systematic Cantonese/Putonghua language training to students from the perspective of contemporary theories of language study. In addition to nurturing students’ language proficiency with substantive knowledge regarding the lexicon and grammar of Cantonese/Putonghua, the curriculum design of the programmes also features applications of current theories of linguistics in language acquisition, cognitive science, as well as culture and society.
For more details on the programmes’ study schemes, course lists and course descriptions, please visit the website (
https://www.yccla.cuhk.edu.hk/minor-prog
). We look forward to seeing you in class!

bodyText:

[UGEB2991] Re-running the Four Areas University GE Course: Viewing Communication from Speech Therapy [UGEB2991] 再次開辦課程通識四範圍科目 — 「從言語治療看溝通」 - Department of Otorhinolaryngology, Head and Neck Surgery
From: CHEUK KIT CHING
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
cynthiacheuk@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
你有否試過失聲、聲音沙啞、口齒不清或者口吃？你身邊有沒有人說話不清、患有認知障礙、自閉症、聽力障礙或者中風？你知道如何幫助他們嗎？
每 10 個人中就有一個人患有至少一種溝通障礙。人們在一生中幾乎不可避免地會遇到言語不清、聲音嘶啞、口吃、自閉症譜系障礙、聽力障礙和認知障礙（癡呆）等症狀的人。沒有言語和聽力科學背景的同學，現在你們有機會學習從語言病理學的角度，瞭解人類交流的基本原理及其障礙！由醫學院言語治療科再次開辦的通識四範圍科目 – 「從言語治療看溝通」，將會用13個星期，帶你認識人類交流基本要素、各種溝通障礙的成因和特徵，以及一些跟患者溝通的實用技巧。想透過通識科目擴闊眼界的你，絕對不能錯過：
科目：UGEB2991 從言語治療看溝通
上課時間：逢星期一09:30 – 12:15（2026-27學年下學期）
地點：信和樓UG層2號演講廳
期待你的參與！
如有任何查詢，歡迎電郵至cynthiacheuk@cuhk.edu.hk。
Have you ever experienced loss of voice, hoarseness, unclear speech, or stuttering? Do you know someone around you who has unclear speech, cognitive impairments, autism spectrum disorder, hearing impairment, or has had a stroke? Do you know how to help them?
One in every 10 people suffers from at least one kind of communication disorder. It is almost inevitable for people to have encountered individuals with unclear speech, hoarse voice, stuttering, autism spectrum disorder, hearing impairment and dementia etc. in their lifetime. For those without a background in speech and hearing sciences, now you can learn more about the fundamentals of communication science from the perspective of speech-language-pathology! The general education course offered by the Division of Speech Therapy, "Viewing Communication from Speech Therapy" is being re-run and will take you through a 13-week journey to explore the essential elements of normal communication, the causes and characteristics of various communication disorders, and practical tips for communicating with patients. If you are eager to broaden your horizons, this is an opportunity you cannot miss:
Course: UGEB2991 Viewing Communications from Speech Therapy
Class Schedule: 09:30 – 12:15, weekly on Monday (Term 2, AY26-27)
Venue: Lecture Theatre 2, UG/F, Sino Building
Looking forward to your participation!
Should you have any queries, please contact us on cynthiacheuk@cuhk.edu.hk.

Announcements
Recruitment of Student Helpers for the Academic Year 2026–2027  2026–2027 年度學生助理招聘 - Brain and Mind Institute
From: Eva Lai
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
evalai@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
The Brain and Mind Institute
is currently seeking highly motivated undergraduate and graduate students to join our research team as
student helpers
in our laboratory. As a member of our team, you will work on research projects focused on the neural basis of language and cognitive development in infants across their lifespan. For more information regarding our research projects, please visit our website:
http://bmi.cuhk.edu.hk.
Responsibilities of this position include collecting EEG and behavioral data; assisting with the preparation of research materials; data entry, management, and analysis; preparing research reports; coding socio-communicative behaviors; transcribing and editing transcripts; providing daily office housekeeping and administrative support; and completing other duties as assigned by supervisors.
Students with the following skills and attributes are encouraged to apply:
A good command of Chinese and English (fluency in Cantonese is advantageous);
Research experience in EEG/fNIRS, big data, and experimental psychology is an advantage;
Proficiency in MS Office or G-Suite and Chinese typing;
Meticulous and detail-oriented;
Punctual, reliable, and trustworthy; and
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
The appointee may work at the University campus, at other locations as required by research needs, or remotely from home.
Availability to work on Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays
is highly preferred. Students from the disciplines of Linguistics, Psychology, Education, and Nursing are preferred, but students of other majors are welcome to apply. Previous experience working with infants or young children is a definite plus.
How to Apply:
Interested parties please complete the online application form:
https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/iRJSf5nH52
Review of applications will start as soon as possible and continue until
30 November 2026
, or until the post is filled. Questions or enquiries can be sent to hkbrain@cuhk.edu.hk. Please note that all personal data collected will be used solely for recruitment purposes.
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

Recruitment: Student Helper
Position Description:
The Infectious Disease Research Team at the Department of Medicine & Therapeutics, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, cordially invites CUHK students to join our clinical vaccine trial support work! Beyond Preservation: AI, Memory, and the Future of Testimony  - Centre for Cultural Studies
From: Miss Manuela Wong
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
manuelawong@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Beyond Preservation: AI, Memory, and the Future of Testimony
How can emerging technologies help us preserve and encounter memories that might otherwise fade from collective consciousness?
Eternal Testimony
is an ongoing project initiated in 2018 to explore new ways of preserving and experiencing the testimonies of survivors of Japanese military sexual slavery. The project creates a virtual experience in which visitors can meet and interact with survivors. In this talk, Prof. Jusub Kim introduces the vision, technological development, and exhibition experiences behind
Eternal Testimony
. He discusses how computational media can transform historical testimony from a static archival record into an interactive and emotionally engaging encounter. Through the project’s development and exhibitions, the talk reflects on the possibilities and challenges of using AI to mediate memory, presence, and human connection. Ultimately,
Eternal Testimony
asks how technologies can contribute to the ongoing transmission of history and the preservation of voices across generations.
Date: 13 Nov 2026, Fri
Time: 4:00 PM – Lecture Begins
Venue: CKB LT3, UG/F, Chen Kou Bun Building, CUHK
Registration:
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13742513
Speaker: Prof. Jusub Kim, Sogang University
Moderator: Prof. PARK SaeHim, CUHK
About the speaker:
Jusub Kim is a creative technologist, researcher, and educator exploring the intersection of art and technology. He previously worked at Rhythm & Hues Studios in Los Angeles, contributing to major Hollywood films including the Oscar-winning Life of Pi. He holds a Ph.D. from the University of Maryland, College Park, and is currently a professor in the Department of Art and Technology at Sogang University, Seoul.
Organized by the MA in Intercultural Studies Programme & Centre of Cultural Studies, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK)
