title: Better Gut, Better Sleep? Gut-Brain Study | Earn up to HKD 500 「腸」通無阻，瞓得更好？「腸·腦」研究 | 最高可獲 HKD 500
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/10/16
»
Announcements
Better Gut, Better Sleep? Gut-Brain Study | Earn up to HKD 500  「腸」通無阻，瞓得更好？「腸·腦」研究 | 最高可獲 HKD 500 - Department of Psychiatry
From: Michael Ng
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
tsztsunng@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
近年醫學界發現，我們的腸道健康與大腦息息相關！原來「便秘」和「睡眠質素」的改變，可能是腦部退化的早期信號。為了深入了解這條神奇的「腸腦連線」，香港中文大學精神科學系睡眠研究組現正招募研究參加者。
研究對象:
年齡介乎 50 至 80 歲
關注腸道健康或者受便秘問題困擾（如排便困難、次數較少等）
沒有腦退化、精神疾病史
參加者需完成以下簡單程序：
填寫問卷 及 進行簡單面談
進行一次非入侵性睡眠檢測
記錄連續兩星期「大便日記」
進行一次結腸運輸試驗
收集一次大便樣本
參與研究費用全免，成功參與者最多可獲 HKD 500 超市禮券的津貼
如對本研究有興趣，請透過以下連結報名參加：
[網址連結:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_eeTcY6hrKILNwhg
]
如對研究內容有任何疑問，歡迎致電 3919 7792 / 9568 9006 或 WhatsApp 9568 9006與負責研究人員聯絡、查詢詳情。謝謝
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Recent research suggests that gut health is closely linked to brain function. Changes in bowel habits (e.g. constipation) and sleep quality may even be early signs of neurodegeneration.
To better understand this “gut–brain axis, we sincerely invite you to take part in our research study.
Who can join:
Aged 50–80
Concerned about gut health or bothered by constipation
No history of dementia or psychiatric disorders
What you will do:
Complete questionnaires and a brief interview
Undergo a sleep assessment
Record a 2-week bowel diary
Complete a colonic transit time test
Collect one stool sample
Incentive:
All assessments are free of charge.
Eligible participants may receive up to HKD 500 in supermarket vouchers upon completion.
Interested? Please sign up here:
[
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_eeTcY6hrKILNwhg
]
Enquiries:
3919 7792 / 9568 9006
WhatsApp 9568 9006
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

歡迎同學、校友、教職員及公眾參加

）

主持：香港中文大學歷史系副教授賀喜教授

https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13735740

fredahui@cuhk.edu.hk

bodyText:

Announcements
[HK$70/hour] Become an EduVenturer: Outdoor Learning Ambassador Programme [時薪HK$70] EduVenturer 教育大使招募：走出課室，累積教育實踐經驗 - Centre for Learning Sciences and Technologies
From: Cyan Yiu
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
cyanyiu@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
EduVenturer
教育大使招募
走出課室・累積教學經驗・帶領學生學習
對教育、戶外學習或教育科技有興趣？香港中文大學學習科學與科技中心（CLST）現正招募學生加入
EduVenturer
教育大使計劃
！
教育大使將協助本地中小學生運用
EduVenture-AI®
參與戶外及實地探究學習，帶領學生完成任務、提供基本技術支援，並與教師及項目團隊合作，在真實教育場景中累積實踐經驗。

參與計劃，你可以得到：
 有薪實踐：時薪 HK$70，按活動時間、地點及行程而定。
 免費培訓：學習使用 EduVenture-AI®，提升活動帶領及教育科技應用能力。
 計劃證書：完成培訓並出席 10 次活動後可獲證書。
 教育實踐經驗：接觸本地學校，累積學生支援及戶外活動帶領經驗。
歡迎不同學科的大學生申請，尤其是教育、地理、歷史、文化研究、社會科學、環境研究及 STEAM 相關學科。申請者須能以廣東話溝通，外向開朗，適應能力強，熱衷戶外工作，喜歡與學生互動，熟悉流動裝置操作，並能解決裝置及 APP 常見問題。

截止報名：
2026
年
10
月
31
日
合適的申請者將獲邀參加 Zoom 面試。

立即報名：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13743656
Become an EduVenturer
Learn Beyond the Classroom. Gain Experience. Support Students.
Interested in education, outdoor learning or educational technology? The Centre for Learning Sciences and Technologies (CLST), The Chinese University of Hong Kong, is recruiting university students for the
EduVenturer Outdoor Learning Ambassador Programme
!
Ambassadors will support local primary and secondary students in outdoor and field-based inquiry learning using
EduVenture-AI®
. You will guide students through learning tasks, provide basic technical support, and work with teachers and the project team to gain practical experience in real educational settings.

What you will gain:

Paid practical experience:
HK$70 per hour, subject to activity arrangements.

Free training:
Develop your skills in using EduVenture-AI®, facilitating activities and applying educational technology.

Programme certificate:
Receive a certificate after completing training and attending 10 activities.

Education experience:
Work with local schools and gain experience in supporting students and leading outdoor activities.
Students from different disciplines are welcome, particularly those studying education, geography, history, cultural studies, social sciences, environmental studies and STEAM-related subjects. Applicants should be outgoing, adaptable, able to communicate in Cantonese, enjoy outdoor duties and interacting with students, familiar with mobile devices and able to solve common mobile device and app issues.

Application deadline: 31 October 2026
Suitable applicants will be invited to a Zoom interview.

Apply now:
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13743656

查詢
/ Enquiries:
eduventure-ai@cuhk.edu.hk

計劃網站
/ Programme website:
https://clst.fed.cuhk.edu.hk/evqef/
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

大學畢業是人生的重要里程碑 與家人、師長和同窗好友合照，記錄珍貴回憶的同時，中大人亦不忘社會責任

實踐關懷社會與環境的精神
在選購畢業照道具前，不妨從 聯合國可持續發展目標（SDGs）12「責任消費與生產」 的角度出發，多想一步，使每個選擇都更具意義，讓珍貴回憶與可持續發展同行
想了解如何以 SDG 12責任消費成就更有意義的畢業時刻？
立即閱讀《畢業留影，責任選擇》小貼士：
https://srsdo.cuhk.edu.hk/images/documents/Graduation_Memories_Responsible_Choices_SDG12.pdf
Graduation is an important milestone in life While celebrating and capturing precious memories with family, teachers and friends, CUHK members can also demonstrate   care and responsibility towards society and the environment
Before purchasing graduation photo props, take a moment to consider your choices through the lens of Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 12: Responsible Consumption and Production. A little extra thought can make every choice more meaningful and allow cherished memories to go hand in hand with sustainability
Interested in learning how to celebrate graduation with SDG 12 Responsible Consumption?
Read the Tips on ‘Graduation Memories, Responsible Choices’ now:
https://srsdo.cuhk.edu.hk/images/documents/Graduation_Memories_Responsible_Choices_SDG12.pdf

【Online Lecture】The Characteristics of "Humanistic" Application in Venerable Master Hsing Yun’s Lyric Creations 星雲大師歌詞創作的「人間」應用特質 星雲大師歌詞創作的「人間」應用特質 - Centre for the Study of Humanistic Buddhism
From: 人間佛教研究中心 Centre for the Study of Humanistic Buddhism

【精彩上線｜紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰系列講座】
為紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰，香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心與佛學研究中心聯合舉辦 「人間佛教的文本、行跡與時代開展」 系列講座。我們特別邀請了宗教學、文學、哲學、出版、媒體與博物館學等領域的頂尖專家學者，帶來 9 場重磅專題演講！內容橫跨跨跨文化對話、文學考察、媒體實踐到新博物館學，從多元視角深化對星雲大師思想的理解。本次系列講座全面開放線上參與，歡迎大眾踴躍共霑法益。
題目：
星雲大師歌詞創作的「人間」應用特質
時間：11月19日 | 週四 14:30 - 16:30
講者：林仁昱教授 | 中興大學中文系特聘教授兼藝術中心主任
主持：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任
形式：ZOOM網絡會議
ZOOM ID: 964 5779 7423，密碼: 999999
報名：https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741303
演講簡介：
星雲大師在倡議與實踐「人間佛教」的道路上，不僅以歌曲來推廣理念，許多歌曲也成為導引新時代儀節與活動的重要部分。從1950年代作〈西方〉以取代念佛共修的傳統迴向四句偈，作〈佛化婚禮祝歌〉來適應建立「佛化家庭」的重要典儀；1970年代作〈三寶頌〉濃縮歷代各種〈三皈依〉偈讚歌詞要義，更方便傳唱應用；到2000年以後，創作眾多「人間音緣」歌詞，廣徵作曲，使相同歌詞可有不同風格的譜曲，靈活運用於各種弘法與社會活動，充分表現「人間」應用的特質。本次講座將順著時代脈絡，剖析歌詞內涵與實際應用情形，論述其具體意義及影響力。
On his path of advocating and practicing "Humanistic Buddhism," Venerable Master Hsing Yun not only promoted Buddhist concepts through songs, but many of his musical works also became essential components guiding rituals and activities in the modern era.
Historically, this practical approach unfolded across several key stages: In the 1950s, he composed Western Land (〈西方〉) to replace the traditional four-line verse for the dedication of merit during collective chanting cultivation, and penned the Blessing Song for Buddhist Weddings (〈佛化婚禮祝歌〉) to accommodate the pivotal rituals of establishing "Buddhist Families." In the 1970s, he authored the Ode to the Triple Gem (〈三寶頌〉), which condensed the essential meanings of various historical verses praising the Three Refuges into a format more accessible for singing and collective use. From 2000 onward, he created numerous lyrics for Sounds of the Human World (「人間音緣」) and openly solicited musical compositions, allowing the same lyrics to be adapted into diverse musical styles and flexibly utilized in various Dharma propagation and social events. This approach fully exemplifies the characteristics of "humanistic" and practical application.
Following a chronological framework, this lecture will analyze the inner connotations and practical applications of these lyrics, discussing their concrete significance and far-reaching influence.
嘉賓簡介：
林仁昱，中興大學中文系特聘教授兼藝術中心主任，以佛教文學與文化、敦煌文獻與文學、歌謠俗曲與風俗為研究領域，重要著作有：《敦煌佛教歌曲之研究》、《廿世紀初中國俗曲唱述人物》、《敦煌佛教讚歌寫本「原生態」與應用研究》，近期刊登於期刊的單篇著作有：〈星雲大師1950－70年代佛教歌詞創作探究〉、〈星雲大師「人間音緣」歌詞的文學表現及其效應〉、〈《觀音十二圓覺》的菩薩化身與度化對象探究〉、〈觀音與地藏組合供奉的信仰意義與衍發現象〉、〈現代東亞佛誕節文藝與文化考察—以臺灣、日本、馬來西亞為探究核心〉等。

【精彩上線｜紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰系列講座】
為紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰，香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心與佛學研究中心聯合舉辦 「人間佛教的文本、行跡與時代開展」 系列講座。我們特別邀請了宗教學、文學、哲學、出版、媒體與博物館學等領域的頂尖專家學者，帶來 9 場重磅專題演講！內容橫跨跨跨文化對話、文學考察、媒體實踐到新博物館學，從多元視角深化對星雲大師思想的理解。本次系列講座全面開放線上參與，歡迎大眾踴躍共霑法益。
題目：
太虛大師的世界佛教運動與文明論述：1920年代為中心
時間：10月27日 | 週二 14:30 - 16:30
講者：龔雋教授 | 中山大學哲學系教授
主持：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任
形式：ZOOM網絡會議
ZOOM ID: 964 5779 7423，密碼: 999999
報名：https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741299
演講簡介：
本次講座立足於思想史的視野與方法，對太虛在1920年代的世界佛教運動及其文明論述進行詳密的討論與分析。分別從三個方面來開展論述。首先，把太虛的東西文明論放置在1920年代中國思想界有關東西文明與文化論爭這一脈絡中來加以審查，以深入理解太虛相關論述的思想史處境。其次，討論太虛歐美布教中的文明論論述，特別闡釋他是如何「格義」佛教與西方的科學、哲學而另立新說。最後，對太虛佛教世界化的文明論述進行評論，闡析其論述背後複雜的思想面向，特別是他的文明論述中所隱含的東方主義及其民族主義觀念。
Grounded in the perspectives and methodologies of intellectual history, this lecture provides a detailed discussion and analysis of Master Taixu’s World Buddhist Movement and his discourse on civilization during the 1920s.
The presentation unfolds across three primary dimensions:First, it situates Master Taixu’s views on Eastern and Western civilizations within the context of the 1920s Chinese intellectual debates surrounding Eastern versus Western civilization and culture, thereby deepening our understanding of the intellectual milieu of his discourse.
Second, it examines Master Taixu’s civilizational discourse during his missionary travels in Europe and America, specifically elucidating how he utilized Geyi (conceptual matching) to interface Buddhism with Western science and philosophy to forge his innovative theories.
Finally, the lecture reflects critically on Master Taixu’s civilizational discourse regarding the globalization of Buddhism, analyzing the complex intellectual dimensions underlying his arguments—particularly the implicit notions of Orientalism and nationalism embedded within his discourse on civilization.
嘉賓簡介：
龔雋教授，現任中山大學哲學系教授、中華外國哲學史學會東方哲學專業委員會副主任、中國社科院評價研究院宗教專業委員會委員，並擔任《新史學》、《漢語佛學評論》、《人文宗教研究》等多種學術刊物編委。主要從事中國佛教思想的教學與研究，代表性著作包括《作為「知識」的近代佛學史論——在東亞視域內的知識史論述》（商務印書館，2019，合著）、《中國禪學研究入門》（復旦大學出版社，2009，合著）及《禪史鉤沉：以問題為中心的思想史論述》（北京三聯書店，2006）。另於海內外學術刊物發表論文四十餘篇。

本次講座立足於思想史的視野與方法，對太虛在1920年代的世界佛教運動及其文明論述進行詳密的討論與分析。分別從三個方面來開展論述。首先，把太虛的東西文明論放置在1920年代中國思想界有關東西文明與文化論爭這一脈絡中來加以審查，以深入理解太虛相關論述的思想史處境。其次，討論太虛歐美布教中的文明論論述，特別闡釋他是如何「格義」佛教與西方的科學、哲學而另立新說。最後，對太虛佛教世界化的文明論述進行評論，闡析其論述背後複雜的思想面向，特別是他的文明論述中所隱含的東方主義及其民族主義觀念。
Grounded in the perspectives and methodologies of intellectual history, this lecture provides a detailed discussion and analysis of Master Taixu’s World Buddhist Movement and his discourse on civilization during the 1920s.
The presentation unfolds across three primary dimensions:First, it situates Master Taixu’s views on Eastern and Western civilizations within the context of the 1920s Chinese intellectual debates surrounding Eastern versus Western civilization and culture, thereby deepening our understanding of the intellectual milieu of his discourse.
Second, it examines Master Taixu’s civilizational discourse during his missionary travels in Europe and America, specifically elucidating how he utilized Geyi (conceptual matching) to interface Buddhism with Western science and philosophy to forge his innovative theories.
Finally, the lecture reflects critically on Master Taixu’s civilizational discourse regarding the globalization of Buddhism, analyzing the complex intellectual dimensions underlying his arguments—particularly the implicit notions of Orientalism and nationalism embedded within his discourse on civilization.

為紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰，香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心與佛學研究中心聯合舉辦 「人間佛教的文本、行跡與時代開展」 系列講座。我們特別邀請了宗教學、文學、哲學、出版、媒體與博物館學等領域的頂尖專家學者，帶來 9 場重磅專題演講！內容橫跨跨跨文化對話、文學考察、媒體實踐到新博物館學，從多元視角深化對星雲大師思想的理解。本次系列講座全面開放線上參與，歡迎大眾踴躍共霑法益。
題目：
從生活邏輯與信仰邏輯的關係看人間佛教
時間：10月20日 | 週二 14:30 - 16:30
講者：唐忠毛教授 | 華東師範大學社會發展學院教授、博士生導師
主持：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任
形式：ZOOM網絡會議

演講簡介：
生活邏輯立足世俗現實，講求日常責任、人倫倫理，以現世生活價值及時代說變遷為導向，佛教信仰邏輯依託佛教義理，以緣起性空、因果解脫、菩薩利他為終極追求，具備出世超越性。人間佛教的核心，就是以中道的立場調和二者的對立割裂，實現入世生活與出世信仰的辯證統一。星雲大師糾正了傳統佛教理解上的兩種偏差：一是偏重信仰邏輯、消極出世，將修行等同於遠離俗世、逃避現實責任，否定現世生活的修行；二是被生活邏輯裹挾，信仰徹底世俗功利化。人間佛教秉持中道立場，主張佛法不離世間覺。一方面，以生活邏輯為信仰的根基，修行不脫離日常起居、家庭倫理與社會事務，強調在人間踐行善行、擔當責任，把世俗生活作為修行道場，認可現世人生的改造價值。另一方面，以信仰邏輯引領淨化世俗生活，秉持“以出世精神做入世事業”，用慈悲、無我、緣起智慧破除世間功利執著，把日常生活昇華為自利利他的菩薩行。要言之，人間佛教不脫離世間、不執著世間，以世俗生活承載信仰實踐，以終極信仰安頓現實人生，完成了生活邏輯與信仰邏輯的融合統一，也適配當代的社會理念。
The "logic of life" is grounded in secular reality, emphasizing daily responsibilities and human ethics, guided by the values of worldly life and temporal changes. Conversely, the "logic of Buddhist faith" relies on Buddhist doctrines, with the ultimate pursuit of dependent origination, emptiness of nature, karmic cause and effect, liberation, and Bodhisattva altruism, possessing a transcendent and world-transcending nature. The core of Humanistic Buddhism lies in using a Middle Way stance to reconcile the opposition and fragmentation between the two, achieving a dialectical unity of world-engaging life and world-transcending faith.
Venerable Master Hsing Yun corrected two deviations in the traditional understanding of Buddhism: first, an overemphasis on the logic of faith leading to passive world-transcendence, equating spiritual cultivation with escaping secular life and evading realistic responsibilities; second, being overwhelmed by the logic of life, leading to the complete secularization and utilitarianism of faith. Humanistic Buddhism upholds the Middle Way stance, asserting that the Buddha-Dharma is not separate from worldly awakening.
On one hand, it treats the logic of life as the foundation of faith, where spiritual practice is intertwined with daily routines, family ethics, and social affairs, emphasizing the practice of wholesome deeds and taking on responsibilities in the human world, thereby transforming secular life into a place of spiritual cultivation (dojo). On the other hand, it guides and purifies secular life through the logic of faith, adhering to the principle of "engaging in worldly enterprises with a world-transcending spirit," using compassion, selflessness, and the wisdom of dependent origination to eradicate worldly and utilitarian attachments. In short, Humanistic Buddhism neither detaches from nor clings to the world; it uses secular life to carry out faith practices and uses ultimate faith to settle reality-based life, completing the integration and unity of the logic of life and the logic of faith, while adapting to contemporary social philosophies.
嘉賓簡介：
唐忠毛教授，哲學博士、歷史學博士後。現任華東師範大學社會發展學院教授、博士生導師，華東師範大學區域文化資源與應用研究中心主任、華東師範大學宗教與社會研究中心副主任。兼任中國宗教學會理事、上海市宗教學會副會長。研究領域集中於佛教學、信仰民俗學、區域文化學等。出版專著多本發表論文多篇，代表論著有《佛教本覺思想論爭的現代性考察》（2006）《中國佛教近代轉型的社會之維——民間上海居士佛教篇組織與慈善研究》（2013）《從空性到體用——中國佛教心性本體論的建構與反思》（2019）等。主持國家社科基金重點、一般等項目多項，參與重大專案多項。近年來完成的國家社科基金項目成果包括《佛教中國化的民間民俗向度研究》《江南“廟-鎮”信仰空間與地方社會研究》等。

唐忠毛教授，哲學博士、歷史學博士後。現任華東師範大學社會發展學院教授、博士生導師，華東師範大學區域文化資源與應用研究中心主任、華東師範大學宗教與社會研究中心副主任。兼任中國宗教學會理事、上海市宗教學會副會長。研究領域集中於佛教學、信仰民俗學、區域文化學等。出版專著多本發表論文多篇，代表論著有《佛教本覺思想論爭的現代性考察》（2006）《中國佛教近代轉型的社會之維——民間上海居士佛教篇組織與慈善研究》（2013）《從空性到體用——中國佛教心性本體論的建構與反思》（2019）等。主持國家社科基金重點、一般等項目多項，參與重大專案多項。近年來完成的國家社科基金項目成果包括《佛教中國化的民間民俗向度研究》《江南“廟-鎮”信仰空間與地方社會研究》等。

【精彩上線｜紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰系列講座】
為紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰，香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心與佛學研究中心聯合舉辦 「人間佛教的文本、行跡與時代開展」 系列講座。我們特別邀請了宗教學、文學、哲學、出版、媒體與博物館學等領域的頂尖專家學者，帶來 9 場重磅專題演講！內容橫跨跨跨文化對話、文學考察、媒體實踐到新博物館學，從多元視角深化對星雲大師思想的理解。本次系列講座全面開放線上參與，歡迎大眾踴躍共霑法益。
題目：
從生活邏輯與信仰邏輯的關係看人間佛教
時間：10月20日 | 週二 14:30 - 16:30
講者：唐忠毛教授 | 華東師範大學社會發展學院教授、博士生導師
主持：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任
形式：ZOOM網絡會議
會議ID: 964 5779 7423，密碼: 999999
報名：https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741297
演講簡介：
生活邏輯立足世俗現實，講求日常責任、人倫倫理，以現世生活價值及時代說變遷為導向，佛教信仰邏輯依託佛教義理，以緣起性空、因果解脫、菩薩利他為終極追求，具備出世超越性。人間佛教的核心，就是以中道的立場調和二者的對立割裂，實現入世生活與出世信仰的辯證統一。星雲大師糾正了傳統佛教理解上的兩種偏差：一是偏重信仰邏輯、消極出世，將修行等同於遠離俗世、逃避現實責任，否定現世生活的修行；二是被生活邏輯裹挾，信仰徹底世俗功利化。人間佛教秉持中道立場，主張佛法不離世間覺。一方面，以生活邏輯為信仰的根基，修行不脫離日常起居、家庭倫理與社會事務，強調在人間踐行善行、擔當責任，把世俗生活作為修行道場，認可現世人生的改造價值。另一方面，以信仰邏輯引領淨化世俗生活，秉持“以出世精神做入世事業”，用慈悲、無我、緣起智慧破除世間功利執著，把日常生活昇華為自利利他的菩薩行。要言之，人間佛教不脫離世間、不執著世間，以世俗生活承載信仰實踐，以終極信仰安頓現實人生，完成了生活邏輯與信仰邏輯的融合統一，也適配當代的社會理念。
The "logic of life" is grounded in secular reality, emphasizing daily responsibilities and human ethics, guided by the values of worldly life and temporal changes. Conversely, the "logic of Buddhist faith" relies on Buddhist doctrines, with the ultimate pursuit of dependent origination, emptiness of nature, karmic cause and effect, liberation, and Bodhisattva altruism, possessing a transcendent and world-transcending nature. The core of Humanistic Buddhism lies in using a Middle Way stance to reconcile the opposition and fragmentation between the two, achieving a dialectical unity of world-engaging life and world-transcending faith.
Venerable Master Hsing Yun corrected two deviations in the traditional understanding of Buddhism: first, an overemphasis on the logic of faith leading to passive world-transcendence, equating spiritual cultivation with escaping secular life and evading realistic responsibilities; second, being overwhelmed by the logic of life, leading to the complete secularization and utilitarianism of faith. Humanistic Buddhism upholds the Middle Way stance, asserting that the Buddha-Dharma is not separate from worldly awakening.
On one hand, it treats the logic of life as the foundation of faith, where spiritual practice is intertwined with daily routines, family ethics, and social affairs, emphasizing the practice of wholesome deeds and taking on responsibilities in the human world, thereby transforming secular life into a place of spiritual cultivation (dojo). On the other hand, it guides and purifies secular life through the logic of faith, adhering to the principle of "engaging in worldly enterprises with a world-transcending spirit," using compassion, selflessness, and the wisdom of dependent origination to eradicate worldly and utilitarian attachments. In short, Humanistic Buddhism neither detaches from nor clings to the world; it uses secular life to carry out faith practices and uses ultimate faith to settle reality-based life, completing the integration and unity of the logic of life and the logic of faith, while adapting to contemporary social philosophies.

Announcements
We need you!! AI+Music!! Recruiting Young Music Lovers | AI and Popular Song Emotion Categorization Research 一齊聽歌! 招募音樂愛好青年｜人工智能與流行歌曲情緒分類研究 - Department of Psychiatry
From: Xiuyang Meng
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
mastersleep@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
招募音樂愛好青年｜人工智能與流行歌曲情緒分類研究
我們正在尋找熱愛音樂的你，參與人工智能與流行歌曲情緒分類研究，用你的聽感為 AI 模型注入真實的青年情緒視角。
研究目的
本研究旨在運用人工智能技術，從青年視角對粵語流行歌曲進行情緒分類標註，評估青年群體對音樂情緒的主觀感知特徵，並為個性化音樂推薦系統及情緒調節相關研究提供數據支持。
招募條件
8 至 24 歲，熱愛音樂且經常聆聽流行音樂，能流暢使用粵語及英語進行溝通與表達的青年。
參與內容
聆聽 50 首粵語流行歌曲，並完整聽畢每首參與標註的曲目，依據自身主觀體驗與即時情緒感受，將歌曲進行情緒分類。
如何加入？
請點擊以下連結進行註冊，並回答幾條簡單問題。研究員將聯絡適合的參加者，詳細解釋研究內容：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_5pU67FrIxYilalw
聯絡我們
如有任何疑問，請於辦公時間內致電 6115-0322 與研究助理陳小姐 或 蒙先生聯絡。
Recruiting Young Music Lovers | AI and Popular Song Emotion Categorization Research
We are looking for music lovers like you to participate in our research on AI and popular song emotion categorization, contributing your listening experience to inject authentic youth emotional perspectives into our AI model.
Purpose of the Study
This study aims to use artificial intelligence technology to annotate the emotion categories of Cantopop songs from a youth perspective, evaluate the subjective emotional perception characteristics of young people towards music, and provide data support for personalized music recommendation systems and emotion regulation-related research.
Eligibility Criteria
Young people aged 18 to 24 who love music, listen to popular music regularly, and are able to communicate fluently in Cantonese and English.
Participation Content
Listen to 50 Cantopop songs in full and categorize each song according to your subjective experience and immediate emotional feelings.
How to Join?
Please click the link below to register and answer a few simple questions. Our researchers will contact eligible participants to explain the study details in full:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_5pU67FrIxYilalw
Contact Us
If you have any questions, please call 6115-0322 during office hours to speak with our research assistants Ms. Chan or Mr. Meng.
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

From: Xingle Gao
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
xinglegao@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
你是否正在受抑鬱情緒困擾，且好似「夜貓」習慣好夜瞓，情緒精力好低？
本研究為一項隨機對照試驗，評估在「夜晚型」抑鬱症青少年中，光治療作為輔助性治療改善情緒和睡眠的效果。
參加者將進行為期 8 週的光治療，期間將有精神科醫生及研究團隊全程跟進，提供專業評估及指導。
參加可獲：
費用全免：所有治療及評估免費。
交通津貼：完成全部研究評估，最高可獲 HKD$1400。
合資格人士需：
年齡 12 至 19 歲
正受抑鬱情緒困擾
習慣成日好夜瞓
如何報名：
請即掃描海報上 QR Code，或點擊下面連結，用 1-3 分鐘填寫簡單問卷作初步篩查。
若合適，研究團隊成員會主動聯絡你，詳細解釋研究。
If you are interested in participating in this study, please complete the survey below. It will take approximately 1–3 minutes. Eligible participants will be contacted for further information.

https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_8BbkFUn0tn570JE
查詢詳情：
請WhatsApp 或致電研究團隊：92916602
辦公時間：星期一至五 10:00-18:00，公眾假期除外

title: 【Overweight or obesity, lifestyle intervention research】 Recruiting individuals with central obeisty aged 40-64 in the study 【改善中央肥胖，生活方式干預研究】中央肥胖改善計劃誠邀40-64歲合資格人士參與
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/10/16
»
Announcements
【Overweight or obesity, lifestyle intervention research】 Recruiting individuals with central obeisty aged 40-64 in the study  【改善中央肥胖，生活方式干預研究】中央肥胖改善計劃誠邀40-64歲合資格人士參與 - Department of Sports Science and Physical Education; Program Director: Prof. Eric Tsz-chun POON
From: HE Ye
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
heye@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港中文大學體育運動科學系誠邀中央肥胖人士參與健康管理研究！
研究目的：
中央肥胖與血糖異常、心血管疾病及其他代謝健康問題的風險增加有關。為應對這一公共健康挑戰，香港中文大學體育運動科學系正開展健康生活方式計劃，提供個人化健康支援。
參加條件：
年齡：40-64歲
平時少做運動/無規律運動習慣
中央肥胖：男性腰圍 ≥ 90 cm; 女性腰圍 ≥ 80 cm
過去三個月體重變動≤5%
現時沒有服用長期藥物
參加方法：
掃描海報二維碼或通過鏈接作網上登記【
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_2bLgS3k7oUW0TMa
】
研究團隊會進行初步篩選，以了解您是否符合基本參加資格
成功通過初步篩選後，預約檢查時間
前往香港中文大學汾陽體育館參加檢查
如果符合參加條件，將會被隨機分組，正式開展後續正式的健康生活方式計劃
參與地點：
香港中文大學汾陽體育館G02室
如您有任何疑問，可通過以下渠道聯絡這項研究的相關人員：
何小姐
WhatsApp: 94463265
電郵: heye@link.cuhk.edu.hk
[
數據安全聲明
]
所有檢測結果加密儲存，僅供研究團隊匿名分析，您可隨時要求刪除個人資料
[
歡迎邀請身邊感興趣的親友參加
]
Study Purpose:
Central obesity is associated with an increased risk of abnormal glucose regulation, cardiovascular disease, and other metabolic health problems. To help address this growing public health concern, the Department of Sports Science and Physical Education at The Chinese University of Hong Kong is launching a Healthy Lifestyle Program that offers personalized health support for individuals with central obesity.
Recruitment criteria:
Aged between 40 and 64 years
No regular exercise habits
Central obesity: waist circumference ≥ 90 cm for men and ≥ 80 cm for women
Body weight fluctuation ≤5% in the past three months
Not taking any chronic medication
Study arrangement:
Scan the QR code to register (
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_2bLgS3k7oUW0TMa
)
The study team will select participants based on the registration information
Arrange a screening time
Arrive at CUHK Kwok Sports Building for the test
If you are eligible, you will be randomly assigned to start the formal Healthy Lifestyle Intervention Program
Study Location:
Room G02, Kwok Sports Building, Department of Sports Science and Physical Education, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shatin
Contact Us
If you are interested and have any inquiries, please feel free to contact us:
Ms. He
WhatsApp: 94463265
Email: heye@link.cuhk.edu.hk
[Data safety] All data obtained during the study will be kept strictly confidential
.
[Welcome to invite friends and family who are interested in participating in our study]

https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

title: 【SIGN UP】HKIAPS Lecture Series no.20 【誠邀參與】香港亞太研究所中午大講堂—戰前香港的唐行婦（Karayuki san）： 以基層女性為視角的社會史（講者：黃可兒小姐）

Announcements
【SIGN UP】HKIAPS Lecture Series no.20 【誠邀參與】香港亞太研究所中午大講堂—戰前香港的唐行婦（Karayuki san）： 以基層女性為視角的社會史（講者：黃可兒小姐） - Hong Kong Institute of Asia-Pacific Studies
From: Hong Kong Institute of Asia-Pacific Studies
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
hkiaps@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
(The application below is conducted in Chinese only.)
日期：2026年10月28日（星期三）
時間：下午12時半至2時
地點：香港中文大學利黃瑤璧樓5樓505室
語言：廣東話
講者：黃可兒小姐
免費登記：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741697
講者簡介：
黃可兒小姐，香港中文大學歷史系畢業，日本語言及教育碩士。研習多年日本歷史，近年專注十九世紀中葉至戰前香港與日本的民間交流，關注日本遊客以至居港日裔群體的跨域活動。研究會同時閱讀兩地歷史資料作對照，並結合親身走訪實地，梳理港日民間層面的流動與社群互動，呈現近代東亞區域的歷史面貌。
講座簡介：
本講座聚焦戰前抵港日籍基層女性「唐行婦」群體，以本港舊地圖、跑馬地墳場墓碑、兩地文獻史料，還原她們在香港的聚居形態、產業活動與本地社群互動。探析香港因航運、煤炭貿易成為東亞唐行婦核心集散地的緣由，結合保良局歷史文物對照近代女性處境，重構香港近代跨境移民與基層社會的真實面貌。

From: Hong Kong Institute of Asia-Pacific Studies

免費登記：

講者簡介：
黃可兒小姐，香港中文大學歷史系畢業，日本語言及教育碩士。研習多年日本歷史，近年專注十九世紀中葉至戰前香港與日本的民間交流，關注日本遊客以至居港日裔群體的跨域活動。研究會同時閱讀兩地歷史資料作對照，並結合親身走訪實地，梳理港日民間層面的流動與社群互動，呈現近代東亞區域的歷史面貌。
講座簡介：
本講座聚焦戰前抵港日籍基層女性「唐行婦」群體，以本港舊地圖、跑馬地墳場墓碑、兩地文獻史料，還原她們在香港的聚居形態、產業活動與本地社群互動。探析香港因航運、煤炭貿易成為東亞唐行婦核心集散地的緣由，結合保良局歷史文物對照近代女性處境，重構香港近代跨境移民與基層社會的真實面貌。

楊幗慧 Ada Yeung
-             花藝師、花療靜觀創立人及園藝治療分享者。

-             希望推動更多人透過禪修、花藝及大自然美學探索自我和找回內在平靜，為社會帶來更多減壓和諧空間。

https://webapp.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/ras/restricted/event?id=116945

Taking the Time to Unwind and Reconnect with Your Inner Self through Flowers

Through the different senses of flowers and gentle mindfulness practices, let’s experience beauty, learn to treat ourselves kindly, and enjoy a moment of peace together.
Workshop Details
Date: 29 October 2026 (Thu)
⏰ Time: 12:30 pm – 2:30 pm
Venue: The Forum, Learning Garden, LG/F, University Library
Language: Cantonese
# Each registrant will be given two stalks of flowers for mindfulness practices.
About the Speaker
Ada Yeung
Florist, Horticultural Therapy Practitioner, and Founder of Floral Mindfulness.
Third-generation successor of Anglo Chinese Florist, an 80-year legacy florist in Hong Kong.
With a background in painting and handicrafts since childhood and over a decade of meditation practice, Ada deeply believes that floral art brings about aesthetic beauty and inner peace.
Dedicated to guiding individuals to discover subtle beauty through meditation, floral arrangement, and natural aesthetics, Ada hopes to co-create harmony in society with event attendees.

【Earn HK$500 coupon】 Recruiting adults (aged 18-65) to participate in research on online therapy for insomnia 【可獲得 500元現金券】招募成年人 (18-65歲)參與失眠的數碼化治療研究 - Psychiatry
From: Charis
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
mastersleep@cuhk.edu.hk

你是否經常在床上輾轉難眠，夜醒或早醒？你並不孤單——許多人都面臨著同樣的問題。我們誠邀您參與研究，讓專業數碼化治療助你改善睡眠！
研究目的
本研究旨在評估市民對數碼化失眠認知行為治療聊天機器人的遵從性，以及其對改善睡眠問題的效果。
治療方式
· 由專業臨床心理學家及精神科醫生設計的電子化治療
· 完全免費
參與資格
· 18至65歲能說廣東話流利溝通（能流利閱讀並理解廣東話）的香港居民
· 在過去一個月內，每週至少三晚出現睡眠困擾
· 最近四周或以上無需長期服藥
參與研究，獲得獎勵！
完成所有治療及後續測試後，您可獲得高達500港幣。
如何加入？
請點擊以下連結進行註冊，並回答幾條簡單問題。研究員將聯絡適合的參加者，詳細解釋研究內容：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_4UPFh054GtJGXX0
聯絡我們
如有任何疑問，請於辦公時間內致電 6115-0322 與研究助理聯絡。
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Do you often toss and turn in bed, wake up frequently at night, or wake up too early? You are not alone—many people experience the same challenges. We invite you to participate in our study and explore professional digital treatment to improve your sleep!
Purpose of the Study
This research aims to evaluate the public’s adherence to a digital insomnia cognitive behavioural therapy chatbot and assess its effectiveness in improving sleep problems.
Treatment Method
· A professionally designed digital therapy created by clinical psychologists and psychiatrists
· Completely free of charge
Eligibility Criteria
· Hong Kong residents aged 18 to 65 who can speak in Cantonese fluently, read and understand Cantonese
· Experienced sleep disturbances at least 3 nights per week in the past month
· No need for long-term medication for the past four weeks or more.
Receive Rewards for Participating!
Upon completion of all treatment sessions and follow-up assessments, participants will receive up to HKD 500.
How to Join?
Click the link below to register and answer a few simple questions. Our researchers will contact suitable participants to provide further details:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_4UPFh054GtJGXX0
Contact Us
If you have any questions, please call 6115-0322 during office hours to speak with our research assistants.

Lecture Demonstration: Cantonese Contemporary Music

29 October 2026 (Thursday), 8:00 pm

Lee Hysan Concert Hall, The Chinese University of Hong Kong

Free admission with registration
Sign up:
https://forms.gle/iitUp9BKi3o6CaR69
The world-renowned
Mivos Quartet
will present works by faculty, students, and recent graduates of the CUHK Department of Music, written in response to the research theme
“Writing Contemporary Music in Cantonese: Practices and Potentialities”
. Each piece explores a range of approaches to composing with Cantonese text — from deriving pitched materials from tonal contours or psychoacoustic analyses of the language, to shaping musical structure through the narrative and poetic qualities of a text.
Before the performance, Prof. Kai-Young Chan will introduce(in Cantonese) the research project and the works featured in the demonstration, followed by a panel discussion (in English) in which the composers and the Mivos Quartet reflect together on contemporary music in Cantonese.

title: Free HPV Screening for Men in Specific Groups [Free!!!] !!!注意: 男性特定群組 HPV 病毒篩查 [費用全免] [$400交通津貼]
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students

2026/10/16

Announcements
Free HPV Screening for Men in Specific Groups [Free!!!] !!!注意: 男性特定群組 HPV 病毒篩查   [費用全免] [$400交通津貼] - Department of Surgery
From: Tim Lau
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
timlau@surgery.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港中文大學泌尿外科研究招募
:
香港中文大學泌尿外科現正進行一項男性特定群體的尿液及生物樣本HPV和病例對照研究。人類乳頭瘤病毒（HPV） 是全球最常見的性傳染病毒之一，能影響男性並導致多種疾病，包括生殖器疣（椰菜花）、陰莖癌、肛門癌 及 口咽癌。然而，男性 HPV 的感染情況一直缺乏研究，而你的參與將有助填補這個重要的知識空白。
本研究旨在了解HPV感染率、患者人口統計特徵、臨床特徵以及被診斷患有HPV相關惡性腫瘤的男性患者的疾病負擔。以評估男性尿液 HPV 測試的準確性，並更深入了解男性感染 HPV的風險因素，以及幫助未來預防及治療策略。
-如初步檢測確診為HPV陽性的患者，或將安排進一步行檢查 (例如:軟式膀胱鏡檢查等等)及跟進複檢。
參加者條件（男性，18歲或以上）：
1) 陰莖癌，肛⾨癌，或咽喉癌患者
2) 曾患性傳染病
3) 曾有同性性⾏為
(參加者太多, 其他組別優先)
4) 慢性前列腺炎患者
地點：沙⽥威爾斯親王醫院
樣本收集： 尿液及尿道拭子、口咽拭子、肛門拭子、冠狀溝拭子
-填寫簡單問卷
-根據情況也可能採集 20 毫升血液
[費用全免]
-完成整個研究計劃後可獲得港幣
$400
津貼
參加者的資料將會以專業方式絕對保密!!
所收集的資料僅用於學術研究用途
名額有限，先到先得!
閣下如對本研究有興趣請透過以下連結報名：
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf__iQ0Ike8hpG6qIm1mjtF0nCTdcPFKT2v9jFARsuZbqjMJw/viewform?usp=header

如有查詢，歡迎電郵: timlau@surgery.cuhk.edu.hk，與研究人員劉先生聯絡。

Free HPV Screening for Men in Specific Groups [Free!!]
The Chinese University of Hong Kong Division of Urology Research Recruitment
The Department of Surgery (Urology), The Chinese University of Hong Kong is currently recruiting participants for a hybrid cohort and case-control study on male urinary HPV.
Human Papillomavirus (HPV) is one of the most common sexually transmitted viruses worldwide. It can affect men and lead to serious conditions including genital warts, penile cancer, anal cancer, and oropharyngeal cancer. However, HPV infection in men remains under-studied. Your cooperation is highly solicited.
This research aims to determine HPV prevalence, patient demographics, clinical characteristics, and disease burden in men. It will also evaluate the accuracy of a new urine-based HPV DNA test and explore risk factors to support future prevention and treatment strategies.
Participants who test positive for HPV in the initial urine test may be invited for further investigations (e.g. flexible cystoscopy) and regular follow-up re-testing.
Eligibility (Males aged 18 or above)
Patients diagnosed with penile cancer, anal cancer, or oropharyngeal cancer
Men with a history of sexually transmitted diseases (STD)
Men who have sex with men (MSM)
[
As there are too many participants, other groups will take priority.
]
Patients with chronic prostatitis / chronic pelvic pain syndrome (CPPS)
Study Location: Prince of Wales Hospital, Sha Tin
Narrative description
Urine sample + swabs (urethral, oropharyngeal, anal, coronal sulcus)
Complete a simple questionnaire
Optional: 20 ml blood sample (if required)
Free of Charge in HPV test !!
Upon successful completion of the study, participants will receive a
HKD 400
travel subsidy
Your Privacy is Fully Protected.
Data will only be used for academic research purposes.
If you are interested, please register via the link below:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf__iQ0Ike8hpG6qIm1mjtF0nCTdcPFKT2v9jFARsuZbqjMJw/viewform?usp=header
Suitable applicants will be contacted shortly.
For inquiries, please email:  timlau@surgery.cuhk.edu.hk
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

Announcements
[HK$300]Brain Health Study  [HK$300]中大醫學院邀您參與腦部健康研究 - CUHK Psychiatry Sleep Assessment Unit
From: Wong Yuen Tung
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
yuentungwong@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
便秘？嗅覺變差？睡覺拳打腳踢？有腦退化家族史？
這些看似平常的小毛病，其實可能是柏金遜症等大腦退化的早期先兆！
提早了解大腦健康，預防神經退化！
中大醫學院睡眠研究小組推出全新手機篩查App，誠邀您參與醫學研究！
研究對象：
年齡介乎
50 至 65 歲
的華人
未確診
任何腦神經退化疾病（如柏金遜症、阿爾茲海默症/失智症等）
參加者需完成以下程序：
參與研究
費用全免
，成功完成相關研究程序者最多可獲
HK$300元超市禮券
作為津貼
階段一：
下載手機程式並完成問卷 （約需 15–20 分鐘）
完成後可獲得早期柏金遜病風險分數
符合資格並完成問卷者可獲 HK$100元超市禮券
階段二：
部分參加者將獲邀進一步參與臨床評估
包括身體檢查、臨床訪談、居家睡眠測試及神經認知測試
符合資格並完成階段二者，可額外獲 HK$200元超市禮券
立刻掃描海報右下方
二維碼 (QR Code)
或
點擊連結
下載程式「柏健通」參與研究
IOS用戶：
https://apps.apple.com/hk/app/%E6%9F%8F%E5%81%A5%E9%80%9A/id1626241589
Android用戶：
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=edu.cuhk.parkinapp.v2
查詢（致電或WhatsApp）：3919 7792 / 5282 5786（研究助理 黃小姐）
Constipated？Weakened sense of smell？Acting out dream during sleep (punching and kicking) ？Having a family history of neurodegenerative disease？
Common issues like these can actually be early warning signs of brain degeneration, including neurodegenerative diseases such as Parkinson’s disease.
Understand your brain health early to prevent neurodegeneration.
Sleep Assessment Unit - Psychiatry, CUHK has launched a brand-new screening App, and we sincerely invite you to join our medical research study.
Target participants：
Chinese aged between 50 to 65 years old
Have NOT been diagnosed
with any neurodegenerative disease (e.g. Parkinson’s disease, Alzheimer’s disease/ Dementia, etc.)
What you will need to do:
Participation is completely free. Those who successfully complete the study procedure can receive up to HK$300 in supermarket voucher as an allowance.
Phase 1:
Download the mobile app "柏健通" and complete the questionnaires (take approximately 15-20 minutes)
An early Parkinson’s disease risk score will be provided upon completion
Eligible participants who complete the questionnaires will receive HK$100 supermarket voucher
Phase 2:
Selected participants will be invited to undergo further clinical assessments
Assessments include physical examination, clinical interviews, sleep studies, and neurocognitive assessments
Eligible participants who complete Phase 2 will receive an additional HK$200 supermarket voucher
Interested parties are welcome to participate by
clicking the links below
or
scanning the QR Code
in the poster to download the "柏健通" mobile application:
IOS users:
https://apps.apple.com/hk/app/%E6%9F%8F%E5%81%A5%E9%80%9A/id1626241589
Android users:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=edu.cuhk.parkinapp.v2
For details and registration enquiries, please contact our hotline: 39197792 or 5282 5786 (WhatsApp) (Research Assistant, Ms Wong)
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

Registration for 2027-28 Master of Arts in Chinese Art History Online Information Session (11 Nov) 報名參加2027-28 中國藝術史文學碩士課程線上簡介會 (11月11日) - Department of Fine Arts
From: Mr Ben Law
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
Benlaw@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Applications Now Open: CUHK MA in Chinese Art History (2027–2028)
The Master of Arts in Chinese Art History at The Chinese University of Hong Kong is the first master's programme in Hong Kong focusing on Chinese art history. It offers broad and robust academic training for students who inspires to explore the historical development of Chinese Art.
Grounded in both ancient and modern Chinese art, the programme adopts diverse Asian perspectives and guides students to understand critical Chinese art history topics across different periods. Students will also have opportunities to engage directly with art professionals and cultural institutions, gaining valuable insights into the latest developments in Chinese art across academia, museums, cultural heritage, and the creative industries.
Online Information Session
Date: 11 November 2026 (Wednesday)
Time: 6:30pm (GMT+8, Hong Kong Time)
Format: Zoom
Programme Information:
https://www.arts.cuhk.edu.hk/~fadept/programmes/ma-in-chinese-art-history/
Registration for Information Session:
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741196
香港中文大學中國藝術史文學碩士課程（2027
–2028

中國藝術史文學碩士課程為香港首個聚焦中國藝術史的課程，為有志於探索中國藝術古今發展史的同學，提供廣博而紮實的學術訓練。

Announcements
[Free of charge] UP TO HKD$1000 ALLOWANCE! Assess the safety, efficacy and tolerability of a CUHK proprietary Chinese medicine formula – A 9-month trial targeting patients with diabetes <6-year disease duration and on two or less oral drugs 津貼高達一千港元!以確認香港中文大學研發的專利中藥配方的安全性、療效及耐受性。招募糖尿病人(六年內確診，飲食控制或服用2種或以下口服糖尿藥)參與為期九個月的研究 - Department of Medicine and Therapeutics
From: Maggie Lee
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
maggielee@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
[
新中藥方劑治療
2
型糖尿病的臨床安全性、有效性和多組評價：對
β
細胞功能和胰島素抵抗的影響】
香港中文大學內科及藥物治療學系與香港中文大學香港中西醫結合醫學研究所現正聯合進行一項為期九個月，以內服中藥(沖劑)治療 2 型糖尿病人
 研究對象：18至80歲華人
沒有重大疾病 (例如:心臟病或中風等重大併發症)
沒有服用中藥
身體質量指數 (BMI) ≥18 kg/m²  (公斤 ÷ 米 ÷ 米)
患糖尿病6 年或以下
目前飲食控制或用2種或以下口服糖尿藥 [例如metformin（品牌藥名：Glucophage）或/及 gliclazide（品牌藥名：Diamicron）]
如不確定自己是否患有糖尿病，但具備以下其中一項風險因素，我們會安排你服用葡萄糖飲料（75 克口服葡萄糖耐量試驗）作篩查
糖尿病家族史 (尤其父母或兄弟姐妹在40歲前診斷 )
代謝綜合症 (3高：高血糖，高血壓，高膽固醇)
超重或肥胖
脂肪肝
多囊卵巢綜合症
妊娠糖尿病病史
研究內容：中西醫評估、心電圖、肝纖維化掃描、抽血檢查、填寫問卷、服用研究中藥或安慰劑等
地點：新界沙田威爾斯醫院，舊座，3 樓，3M 病房 - 糖尿及內分泌研究中心
參與研究費用全免，成功參與者可獲得高達港幣 $1,000 的津貼，名額有限，先到先得！
閣下如對本研究有興趣請透過以下連結報名參加：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_1EK8XyC5ac5ykiG
如果初步合適參與研究，負責同事將稍後聯絡你，謝謝
如對研究內容有任何疑問，歡迎致電  3505 3897 / 6937 3365 或 WhatsApp 6937 3365與負責研究人員聯絡、查詢詳情。
[Clinical safety, efficacy and multiomic evaluation of a novel Chinese Medicine formula in Type 2 diabetes: Effects on beta-cell function and insulin resistance
.]
Department of Medicine and Therapeutics and Hong Kong Institute of Integrative Medicine, CUHK are jointly conducting a 9-month clinical study on the use of oral Chinese medicine (granule form) for treating type 2 diabetes.
Eligibility Criteria: Ethnic Chinese individuals aged 18 to 80 years
No major illnesses (e.g., heart disease or stroke)
Not taking Chinese medicine
Body Mass Index (BMI) ≥ 18 kg/m² (kg ÷ metre ÷ metre)
Diagnosed with type 2 diabetes within the past 6 years
Diet control alone or taking no more than 2 oral diabetes medications [e.g., metformin (Glucophage®) and/or gliclazide (Diamicron®)]
Not sure if you have diabetes? If you have any of the following risk factors, we can arrange a 75 g Oral Glucose Tolerance Test (OGTT) for diabetes screening
Family history of diabetes (especially if parents or siblings were diagnosed before age of 40)
Metabolic syndrome (three highs: high blood sugar, high blood pressure, high blood cholesterol)
Overweight or obesity
Fatty liver
Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS)
History of gestational diabetes

Study Procedures: Chinese and Western medical assessments, Electrocardiogram (ECG), Liver fibrosis scan, Blood tests, Questionnaire completion, Taking either the study Chinese medicine or a placebo
Location: Ward 3M, 3/F, Old Block, Diabetes and Endocrinology Research Centre, Prince of Wales Hospital, Sha Tin, New Territories
Free of charge to participate.
Successful participants may receive an allowance of up to HKD $1,000.
Limited quota – first come, first served!
Register via the following link:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_1EK8XyC5ac5ykiG
If you are eligible based on initial assessment, our research team will contact you shortly. Thank you!
For inquiries, please contact:
3505 3897 / 6937 3365
WhatsApp: 6937 3365

For enquiries, please write to:

Midday Oasis: CUHK Christian Band Concert   「午間心靈綠洲」: 中文大學基督徒樂隊音樂會 - Chaplain's Office, Chung Chi College
From: Chaplain's Office
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
chaplaincy@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
誠邀大家出席即將舉行的Midday Oasis。
今次想為大家介紹中文大學基督徒樂隊。
他們今次一行五人，會帶來不同風格的基督教音樂，同大家分享信仰裡不同的面向——
有輕快的，有沉靜的，有問自己是誰的，也有慢慢願意走出來的。
曲風不一，卻都是他們真心想唱給人聽的歌。
他們希望，音樂可以成為一道門。除了讓人慢慢認識這個信仰，也希望在這個不太平靜的世界裡，大家可以坐下來，聽聽年輕人的聲音，讓心靈有一刻安放。
就算你未曾接觸過這個信仰，又或者只是午間路過，也歡迎來聽一聽。
You are warmly invited to the coming Midday Oasis.
This time, I would like to introduce the CUHK Christian Band.
Five of them will be with us. They will bring Christian music of many different styles and share different sides of the faith — some light, some quiet, some asking who we are, some slowly willing to step out.
The styles differ, but each song is one they truly want to sing for others.
They hope music can be a door. Beyond coming to know this faith, they also hope that, in a world that is not always calm, we might sit for a while, listen to the voices of young people, and let the heart rest.
Even if you have never come across this faith, or are only passing by at midday, you are welcome to come and listen.

各位︰
「嶺南文化與世界」公開講座系列2026──藝文嶺南：工藝、詩畫與人文景觀，由香港中文大學中國文化研究所嶺南文化研究計劃與香港公共圖書館聯合主辦，兩場知識與美學兼具的專題講座將於10 月 25 日（日）及11 月 28 日（六）在香港中央圖書館演講廳舉行。
兩場專題講座聚焦嶺南在跨域交流中的文化生產與藝術創造，從清代廣州工藝實踐與嶺南羅浮人文地景兩個主題切入。一方面，探討廣東銅胎琺瑯器如何在中外貿易背景下融合西洋裝飾元素，體現廣州工匠對外來技術與審美的創新轉化；另一方面，考察蘇軾嶺南詩文對地方知識、人文景觀與文化記憶的建構作用，以及清代與之相關的《羅浮香影圖》。透過工藝、詩畫與人文景觀的視角進行觀察，本系列將展現嶺南文化在跨域和歷史互動中的創新活力。
本講座系列為香港研究資助局協作研究計劃「嶺南文化與世界」項目（2023–2026）活動，亦是弘揚中華文化系列的活動之一。

–2026）
Art and Literature of Lingnan: Craftsmanship, Poetic Painting, and Humanistic Landscape, Public Lecture Series on “Lingnan Culture and the World” 2026
The Public Lecture Series on “Lingnan Culture and the World” 2026, themed “Art and Literature of Lingnan: Craftsmanship, Poetic Painting, and Humanistic Landscape” and jointly organised by the Institute of Chinese Studies of the Chinese University of Hong Kong and the Hong Kong Public Libraries, features two insightful talks exploring the aesthetic side of Lingnan.  Two lectures will be held at the Lecture Theatre of the Hong Kong Central Library on 25 October (Sunday) and 28 November (Saturday).
The two lectures, one focused on the craftsmanship of the region during the Qing
era, and the other on the humanistic landscape of Luofu, reveal how cross-regional interactions drove cultural and artistic production in Lingnan. The first lecture looks at how China’s trade with the West introduced Western decorative elements into Canton enamelled copperware, showcasing Guangzhou craftsmen’s innovative reinterpretation of Western techniques and aesthetics. The second lecture shifts focus to Su Shi’s Lingnan-themed verses, examining the construction of Lingnan’s humanistic landscape and cultural memory, as well as the creation of the
Paintings of Fragrant Dream of Luofu
during the Qing
dynasty. Approaching the core theme through the lens of craftsmanship, poetic painting, and humanistic landscape, this series reflects the innovative dynamics of Lingnan culture in cross-regional and historical interactions.
This public lecture series is part of RGC Collaborative Research Project “Lingnan Culture and the World” (2023–2026) and is also one of the activities in the Chinese Culture Promotion Series.

2027/28 Admissions Event: "Meet and Greet" Thursday with DSCCC (29 Oct 2026) 崇基學院2027/28年度招生活動：週四見面會 (10月29日) - Divinity School of Chung Chi College
From: Divinity School of Chung Chi College
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
events@theology.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
崇基學院2027/28年度招生活動：「Meet and Greet」週四見面會 (10月29日)
秋意漸濃，不如趁年末，為自己的神學路向「充充電」？
不少朋友都曾表示，在修讀神學之前，最想了解的是「老師是怎樣的？」、「神學院的環境如何？」——不妨親身來到崇基神學院看看，不必帶著一堆疑問自行猜測！
當晚你可參與由本院神學生負責的週四崇拜，崇拜後將有時間與老師一對一傾談，亦可藉此機會認識本院的同學，親身感受這裡的氛圍與氣息。
活動費用全免，並會提供簡便晚餐，請放心赴會！
無論你剛開始思考、仍有猶豫，或已帶著一堆問題想發問——我們都歡迎你前來坐坐，與我們聊聊。
出席老師：葉漢浩教授、白德培教授 (Prof. Tobias Brandner)、溫誠敦教授 (Prof. Bruce Worthington)、朱安之教授、駱頴佳博士、姚志豪牧師、邵倩文副校牧
日期：2026年10月29日（四）晚上6時至9時
地點：香港中文大學崇基學院容啟東校長紀念樓G樓聖堂
截止報名：2026年10月23日（五）
（
如今次未能出席，下一場將於明年3月舉行，敬請留意我們稍後的公佈！）
網上報名 ：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13743164
招生詳情：
https://www.theology.cuhk.edu.hk/admissions
"Meet and Greet" Thursday Gathering
As autumn deepens, why not use this end-of-year moment to "recharge" your theological journey?
Many friends have shared that before studying theology, what they most want to know is: "What are the teachers like?" and "What's the atmosphere at the Divinity School of Chung Chi College?" — why not come see for yourself, instead of guessing with a head full of questions!
That evening, you're welcome to join the Thursday Service led by our Theology students. After the service, there'll be time for one-on-one conversations with our teachers, as well as a chance to meet fellow students and experience the atmosphere here firsthand.
The event is completely free, and a light dinner will be provided — so come with an easy heart!
Whether you're just starting to consider this path, still have some hesitations, or already have a long list of questions — you're warmly invited to come, sit with us, and have a chat.
Teachers joining us: Prof. Ip Hon-ho Alex, Rev. Prof. Tobias Brandner, Prof. Bruce Worthington, Prof. Gillian Chu, Dr. Lok Wing-kai Peter, Rev. Yiu Chi-ho, and Miss Vicky Shiu.
Date: Thursday, 29 October 2026, 6:00 – 9:00pm
Venue: Divinity School Chapel, G/F, President Chi-tung Yung Memorial Building, Chung Chi College, CUHK
Registration deadline: Friday, 23 October 2026
(
If you can't make it this time, our next session will be held in March next year — stay tuned for more details!)
Register online：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13743164
Admissions information：
https://www.theology.cuhk.edu.hk/admissions
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

title: [Taster Event] Greater Bay Area Day Trip with IBCE and ABS - Transfer-in Business Programmes (6 November)
bodyText:

Announcements
[Taster Event] Greater Bay Area Day Trip with IBCE and ABS - Transfer-in Business Programmes (6 November)  - Global Business Programmes, CUHK Business School
From: Global Business Programmes
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
denniswong@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Dear first-year students,
Ready to transform your university experience and stand out in today’s competitive business landscape?
The
International Business and Chinese Enterprise (IBCE)
and
Asian Business Studies (ABS)
transfer-in programmes are designed to cultivate regional expertise across diverse business contexts, while developing career readiness, professional networks, and focused skill sets.
To experience firsthand how IBCE and ABS can help you achieve your goals, we invite you to join our exclusive taster event - the
Greater Bay Area Day Trip on 6 November
!
As a core part of our professional training, the day trip is designed to enhance students’ regional business exposure. You will visit the thriving Greater Bay Area, a key driver of China’s technological advancement and economic growth, and bridge classroom knowledge with real-world business strategy.
Event Highlights
Go behind the scenes at two Chinese technology companies:
Sunwoda Electronic Co Ltd and UBTECH Robotics
to understand the latest developments in lithium-ion batteries and robotics
Gain strategic insights through interactive sessions with senior executives
Learn how these companies navigate and lead within Asia’s complex business landscape
Meet our Programme Director and current IBCE/ABS students to learn about the programme experience
Event Details
Date
: 6 November 2026 (Friday)
Time
: 08:30 – 18:00
Meeting Point
: Futian Port
Itinerary
: Visit Sunwoda Electronic Co Ltd (AM) and UBTECH Robotics (PM)
Cost
: Free of charge
Transportation
: Shuttle bus service will be provided within Shenzhen. Participants are responsible for their own transportation between Hong Kong and Shenzhen.
Lunch
: Self-arranged at your own expense
Important Note
: Check the validity of your travel document and renew it if needed. Verify visa requirements for China and make your own arrangements in advance, if necessary.
Spaces are limited. To secure your spot, please complete this
webform
by 25 October
. Successful applicants will receive a confirmation email before the event.
We look forward to sharing a rewarding learning experience with you!
Should you have any questions, please feel free to contact Mr. Dennis Wong at
denniswong@cuhk.edu.hk
or 3943 7643.
Best regards,
Dennis Wong
Programme Manager
Global Business Programmes
Undergraduate Office
CUHK Business School
T +852 3943 7643 | F +852 2603 5181
4/F, Cheng Yu Tung Building, 12 Chak Cheung Street, Shatin, Hong Kong

【Register Now】International Summit on Pain Research - A CUHK and CUHK-Shenzhen Joint Forum (15 October 2026)  - Peter Hung Pain Research Institute
From: Peter Hung Pain Research Institute
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
phpainresearch@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Dear all,
We cordially invite you to attend our upcoming
International Summit on Pain Research -
A CUHK and CUHK-Shenzhen Joint Forum
on
15 October 2026 (Thursday)
at Lecture Theatre 2, G/F, Yasumoto International Academic Park (YIA).
Featuring renowned speakers from the US, UK and Mainland China, the forum will delve into circuit mapping, neural mechanisms, and novel therapeutic opportunities in pain research.
In addition, emerging young researchers will share their latest findings and showcase cutting-edge translational research spanning microglial priming, hydrogel brain interfaces, and VR pain therapies.
For more details on the programme and speakers, please visit our website:
https://www.phpri.cuhk.edu.hk/news/peter_hung_pain_research_institute_international_summit_on_pain_research_cuhk_and_cuhk-shenzhen_joint_forum.html
CME/ CPD Accreditation:
The Hong Kong College of Anaesthesiologists (HKCA) – 3 points
Hong Kong College of Physicians (HKCP) – 2.5 points
Registration
:
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13738815
Should you have any questions or require further details, please do not hesitate to contact us.
We look forward to seeing you at the forum. Thank you!

title: CALL FOR PROPOSALS | Participation in the 17th Chinese National Arctic Research Expedition 2027 | HKPSIC
bodyText:

CALL FOR PROPOSALS | Participation in the 17th Chinese National Arctic Research Expedition 2027 | HKPSIC  - Hong Kong Polar Science Innovation Centre
From: Yolanda YIM
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
yolandayim@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
An Opportunity to Conduct Research in A
rctic Regions
_________________________________________________________________________________________
The Hong Kong Polar Science Innovation Centre (HKPSIC) is pleased to invite proposals from scientists and researchers interested in participating in the
17th
Chinese National Arctic
Research Expedition 2027
.
Research opportunities are available at
Arctic Ocean Expedition with Xuelong or Xuelong 2, Yellow River Station
and
China-Iceland Arctic Science Observatory (CIAO)
in Arctic Regions. All proposals and personnel nominations will be reviewed and selected by the Polar Research Institute of China (PRIC).
This opportunity is primarily open to researchers from universities in Hong Kong.
Expedition Purpose
The expedition will be conducted for
scientific research purposes
.
Research Opportunities
Arctic Ocean Expedition with Xuelong or Xuelong 2
Quota:
Tentatively 1-2 participants
(Subject to adjustment based on the approved research proposals.)
Eligibility:
PhD candidates
Postdoctoral fellows
Academic staff and researchers
Duration:
Approximately 2–4 months at the station
Tentative departure from Shanghai aboard the icebreaker
Xuelong
or
Xuelong 2
in June or July 2027
Return to Shanghai in Sep or Oct 2027
Additional travel time should be allowed for flights to Shanghai
Yellow River Station
Quota:
1–2 participant(s)
Eligibility:
PhD candidates
Postdoctoral fellows
Academic staff and researchers
Duration:
Approximately 1- 2 week(s) at the station
Tentative departure from Longyearbyen to the station in Aug or Sep
Additional travel time should be allowed for flights to Longyearbyen and from Hong Kong
China-Iceland Arctic Science Observatory (CIAO)
Quota:
1–2 participant(s)
Eligibility:
PhD candidates
Postdoctoral fellows
Academic staff and researchers
Duration:
Approximately 1- 2 week(s) at the station
Tentative departure from Akureyri and drive to the station in Aug or Sep
Additional travel time should be allowed for flights from Hong Kong to Reykjavík, onward travel to Akureyri, and ground transportation to the station.
Priority consideration:
Applicants with existing research collaborations or academic connections in Iceland
Research Instruments
As the icebreakers
Xuelong
and
Xuelong 2
will depart from Shanghai, PRIC recommends that any required research instruments be shipped to Shanghai no later than
April-May
for loading and transportation to the Arctic research stations.
Health and Visa Requirements
Selected participants will be required to:
Complete a medical examination specified by PRIC
Submit a medical report for review
Obtain a Schengen visa for Yellow River Station or CIAO
Participants should allow sufficient time for medical examinations and visa applications.
Clothing and Equipment
PRIC will provide basic expedition clothing and equipment, including:
Expedition jackets
Trousers
Thermal wear
Sunglasses
Other essential gear
These items will be provided to selected participants before departure.
Expenses to Be Covered by Participants
Participants are responsible for all associated expenses, including:
International airfares
Accommodation on the stations before and after station entry/exit or during the expedition in the stations
(Accommodation on Xuelong or Xuelong 2 is provided free of charge)
Travel insurance
Visa application fees (if applicable)
Medical examination fees
Shipment and transportation costs for research instruments and equipment
Any other incidental expenses
Proposal Submission
Researchers who are able to meet the above requirements and schedule are invited to submit an email request to obtain the proposal template.
Submission Deadline
10 November 2026 (Tuesday)
All proposals will be forwarded to PRIC for evaluation and selection. HKPSIC will provide support to participating researchers and facilitate communications with PRIC throughout the application and preparation process.
Enquiries
Secretariat
Hong Kong Polar Science Innovation Centre (HKPSIC)
Email: hkpsic@cuhk.edu.hk
Tel: 3943 0345
We sincerely encourage interested researchers to take advantage of this unique opportunity to conduct scientific research in Arctic Regions and contribute to polar research collaboration.
We look forward to receiving your proposals.
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

: “

”
As

60th Anniversary
, we are not only reflecting on six decades of excellence, innovation, and impact, but also looking ahead to the future of education in an increasingly AI-driven world.
To mark this milestone, we are pleased to invite you to join us on 6 November 2026 (Fri) for a series of celebration activities
,

Graduate School Seminar 202
6:
“
AI in Education

, a

bringing together speakers, students, and alumni from diverse backgrounds and disciplines, as well as a
mini exhibition
showcasing the Graduate School’s history and achievements.
Jointly organised by the CUHK Graduate School and the Federation of Graduate School Alumni Associations (FGSAA), the
Graduate School Seminar 2026: "AI in Education"
presents a forward-looking dialogue on how artificial intelligence is transforming teaching and learning, research, and graduate education.
We are honoured to welcome three distinguished speakers who will share their insights on the evolving role of AI in education in keynote speeches and panel discussion:

"From Knowledge to Discovery: AI and the Future of Graduate Education"
Professor Irwin KING

- Professor, Department of Computer Science and Engineering

- Executive Director, Hong Kong Education City
- Graduate of

Invitation to ICS Public Lecture – Dr. Jennifer Dorothy Lee on 15 October 2026 誠邀參加中國文化研究所訪問學人公開講座──李晉美博士（芝加哥藝術學院） - Institute of Chinese Studies
From: Amber Lam
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ics-activities@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
You are cordially invited to attend a public lecture organised by the Institute of Chinese Studies (ICS) at The Chinese University of Hong Kong on Thursday, 15 October 2026. It is our honour to welcome Dr. Jennifer Dorothy LEE, ICS Visiting Fellowship visiting scholar from the School of the Art Institute of Chicago, to deliver a talk on the topic:
“Shuttered Eyes, Kinship Threads: Tracing Music and Migration in the Family of Yo-Yo Ma”
.
Abstract:
What can a single photograph say? The black-and-white artefact featured in this talk, a product of the Nanjing Guanghua Photo Studio, shows a family like many others in 1946, caught between wars and continents. The figures pictured are musicians, primarily, but also teachers, scientists, and jacks-of-all-trades. They are the progenitors of the famed cellist Yo-Yo Ma, of his sister Yeou-Cheng, and of me. Drawing on lenses that range from music to art history to something akin to critical fabulation, I unfold the episodic, recursive process of unearthing my family history for the very first time. The process starts from initial encounters with a single photograph that cue a forensic exploration, compelling me to extract from handwritten letters, intimate anecdotes, musical manuscripts, and persistent memories. At certain points, through an historian's microscope, I reconstruct the spaces in which these familial figures lived and breathed. At other points, I activate imaginative techniques, such as the musical notations they leave behind, to piece together the facts and fabulations of the past.
Speaker:
Dr. Jennifer Dorothy Lee

From: Amber Lam
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ics-activities@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
You are cordially invited to attend a public lecture organised by the Institute of Chinese Studies (ICS) at The Chinese University of Hong Kong on Thursday, 29 October 2026. It is our honour to welcome Prof. Ping WANG, ICS Visiting Fellowship visiting scholar from Department of Asian Languages and Literature at the University of Washington, to deliver a talk on the topic: "Untranslating the Poet-Transcendent: Li Bo (701–762) Between Cosmology and Equivalence".
Abstract:
Large language models now translate between languages in seconds, reviving an old anxiety: is translation a solved problem? This talk argues that for understanding a culture, fluency was never the difficulty. Taking the great Tang poet Li Bo as its case, it follows a singularly iconic word, xian 仙, the term behind his epithet "poet-transcendent," as it passes into English. In medieval China, a xian was not merely a being who does not die; a xian held rank and office in a celestial bureaucracy, and could be demoted from it. To render Li Bo a "banished immortal" keeps the exile but quietly drops that cosmic officialdom, leaving behind a familiar romantic genius. For a century "immortal" was the dominant English choice, canonized in dictionaries and anthologies until it seemed self-evident. Machine translation, trained on that same archive, reproduces the reduction as its frictionless default, laying bare how thoroughly it saturated the record. The question, then, is not whether cultures can be translated, but how a concept, precisely by resisting translation, becomes a shared medium for thinking transcendence.
Speaker:
Ping Wang is Professor in the Department of Asian Languages and Literature at the University of Washington, where she teaches classical Chinese literature and researches the history of Chinese poetry. She has previously held faculty positions at the University of Wisconsin and Princeton University, prior to joining the University of Washington.
Professor Wang's scholarship bridges Western sinology, translation studies, traditional Chinese classical learning, and contemporary critical theory. She has published numerous articles and is the author of
The Age of Courtly Writing: Wen xuan Compiler Xiao Tong (501-531) and His Circle
and
The Poetic Way of Xie Lingyun
, the latter of which examines the significance of landscape poetry (shanshui shi) in Chinese literary history.
Her honors include a research membership at the Institute for Advanced Study, Princeton, a special Andrew W. Mellon Foundation grant for international collaborative research, and a research fellowship from the Simpson Center for the Humanities at the University of Washington. In 2017, she was invited to lecture at the University of Ljubljana in Slovenia, and she is currently a resident fellow of the Institute of Chinese Studies at The Chinese University of Hong Kong.

Invitation to Translation Talks @ CUHK #3: Ecotranslation for the Sake of Environmental Education  - Department of Translation
From: Katie Cheung
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
katiecheung@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
The Department of Translation is pleased to invite you to the third session of our
Translation Talks @ CUHK
series:
Ecotranslation for the Sake of Environmental Education
Speaker:
Prof. Darryl Cameron Sterk
Affiliation:
Lingnan University

Date:
23 October 2026 (Friday)

Time:
12:30 p.m.

Venue:
Room 214, Li Dak Sum Building, CUHK
In this engaging talk, Prof. Sterk will explore how translation can contribute to environmental education and biodiversity awareness. Drawing on examples from bilingual digital databases, visual media, and emerging AI applications, he will discuss how ecotranslators, educators, scientists, and policymakers work together to make knowledge about nature more accessible to the public.
This lecture offers a unique opportunity to discover the intersections between translation, ecology, technology, and education, while reflecting on how language can help foster a deeper understanding of the natural world.
About the Speaker
Prof. Darryl Cameron Sterk is an Associate Professor of Translation at Lingnan University, Hong Kong. His research focuses on the role of translation in minority language revitalization, particularly in the era of digital communication and technological innovation.

Registration:
Please register via the QR code on the poster or through the registration link provided.
https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/T66DURZtLz
We warmly welcome all students, staff, researchers, and members of the public who are interested in translation studies, environmental communication, and interdisciplinary research.
We look forward to seeing you at the talk.

For non-tonal language speakers What's the difference between mā and má? Get 400 HKD to discover !！-Month2  - Department of Linguistics and Modern Languages
From: CAI Penghao
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
penghaocai@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Can you hear the difference between mā and má? How does your brain learn language tones? Join our study and put your ears to the test!
In our study, you will attend two sessions:
In the first session (EEG), you will wear a comfortable sensor cap so we can record your brain activity while you listen to sounds. (Safe & Non-invasive!)
In the second session (Behavioral), you will conduct interactive computer-based tasks that test your focus and memory.
NO
prior experience with Mandarin or Cantonese is required — we welcome everyone as long as you are eligible!
Location: the Chinese University of Hong Kong
What You’ll Get
A unique opportunity to see how your brain works
Learn something new about tones and language learning
$400 compensation for your time
If you’re interested, sign up here:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScisZwrnju0zMkecXd0vFTyBS03moME0Ix8uVxSJSwEzFeMLw/viewform

We will contact you later to schedule an experiment with you if you are eligible.
Eligibility
:
Aged 18–30; NOT majoring in psychology or linguistics.
Be a non-tonal language native speaker (e.g. non-Mandarin/non-Cantonese).
Normal hearing and vision.
No history of brain injury, epilepsy, or other neurological conditions; no scalp injuries or infections.
Right-handed, healthy, no hair dyeing within two weeks before the experiment.
For inquiries, please contact:
penghaocai@cuhk.edu.hk

Join us at “Study in Europe Fair” at YIA on Friday, 23 October!

The third edition of the
Study in Europe Fair
will take place on Friday, 23 October! The event is proudly organised by the European Union Office to Hong Kong and Macao in cooperation with Consulates-General of EU Member States and The Chinese University of Hong Kong. It is a must-attend event for all Hong Kong students interested in pursuing an academic exchange or a degree programme in Europe.
Three highlights of the event:
12 EU countries showcasing a wide range of study and exchange opportunities for undergraduates and postgraduates students from Hong Kong, including scholarships
Discover the EU's flagship Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters programmes and scholarship opportunities
Chat with local alumni and hear about their unique study experiences in Europe!

Want to gain real research experience while supporting a meaningful project for Hong Kong’s business community in the digital age?

We are now recruiting part-time student helpers to support our survey and interview activities.

講者 Speaker: 門泊舟博士 Dr. MEN Bozhou
主持 Moderator: 蔣元秋博士 Dr. JIANG Yuanqiu
日期 Date: 16 / 10 / 2026 (Fri)
時間 Time: 4 p.m. - 6 p.m.
地點 Venue: 香港中文大學 大學書店（康本國際學術園一樓） University Bookstore (YIA 1/F), CUHK
普通話主講 In Putonghua
簡介 Synopsis
當奧德修斯重返伊塔卡，珀涅羅珀二十年的等待終得回報。但好奇的讀者或許也曾有一閃念：如果珀涅羅珀沒有選擇等待呢？本講座通過文學中的對照手法，看看荷馬是否在《奧德賽》中留下一些線索來回答這個問題。我們也會討論：女性命運抉擇的背後，究竟牽扯到怎樣激烈的政治交鋒和殘酷的時代印記。

Wish to transform your R&D results to a real business and become an entrepreneur?
If you wish to turn your research output into a real business, please consider applying for the
Technology Startup Support Scheme for Universities (TSSSU)
. Or, if your students wish to commercialize their R&D results, please also encourage them to apply for TSSSU.
Successful applicants may receive
Up to HK$600,000 funding per year for potentially up to three years
Potential to join HKSTP’s Incubation Programme
Access to potential investors & industry partners
Mentorship from experienced entrepreneurship consultant
Apply Now IF
Your idea is innovative, your team is capable, your innovation and technology are unique and your business plan is sound
Your team wants to make a societal impact and is passionate about entrepreneurship
Eligibility of a PIC
The Person-in-Charge (PIC) of a CUHK TSSSU company must be a full-time CUHK student, a full-time CUHK professor, or alumni graduated within the last three years.
Compulsory Requirements:
For TSSSU-O & TSSSU+ applications, preference will be given to those who are
entitled to exploit technology owned or licensed from CUHK
(excluding those technology developed from InnoHK Centres incorporated by CUHK)*.
The technology involved in the application must reach the required Technology Readiness Level (TRL).
Physical Science and Engineering technology must reach TRL 4 or above
and
HealthCare technology must reach TRL 3 or above
.
The number of members of the Company must be
at least two
including the eligible PIC. Active members of CUHK should be the effective majority of shareholders of the Company.
Fulfill all the eligibility requirements in CUHK TSSSU Guideline 202
7
-2
8
.
(TSSSU+ only) The assessment panel shall review the investment arrangement during the assessment process per the request of ITC.  Please submit the
agreement
issued by the private investor together with the applications.  If the agreement has not yet been signed, please submit the latest available draft agreement.
* If a patent application has not been filed at the time of submission of a TSSSU-O or TSSSU+ application, the applicant should consider submitting an Invention Disclosure Form or a Copyright Disclosure Form and Assignment to the KTO IP and Technology Licensing Team.

MPSS -
LivingWorks safeTALK (English)
Dear Students,
Do you want to support your friends, classmates, or anyone in need? Join us for LivingWorks safeTALK, a four-hour, internationally recognized training that equips people to be more alert to someone thinking of suicide and better able to connect them with further help.
Through this workshop, you will learn the simple and practical TALK model:
Tell: Tell someone directly that you’re concerned
Ask: Ask clearly and openly about suicide
Listen; Listen with empathy and without judgment
KeepSafe: Keep the person safe by connecting them to appropriate resources

Dear Students,
To strengthen non-local students' resilience and equip students to cope with life’s challenges, sign up for the 12-hour Mental Health First Aid Standard Course taught by qualified counsellors who are certified MHFA trainers by The Mental Health Association of Hong Kong.
Upon completion of the course, participants will be able to:
Identify the signs and symptoms of common mental health and substance use challenges;
Provide someone with initial support until they are connected with appropriate professional help;
Identify risk factors and warning signs for mental health and addiction concerns; and
Learn strategies to help someone in both crisis and non-crisis situations, and know where to turn for help.

Voices of the CU-riosities
Starting from zero to build a book house in Africa — How?
"We hope this building gives Kibera's children a place to play, learn, and belong, it can show the world and the next generation of architects that design has the power to change lives," said Associate Professor Peter Winston Ferretto, Director of the School of Architecture at CUHK, who led the project, summing up his and his students' aspiration in a few words.
The project is called the Amani Kibera Book House. "Amani" means peace in Swahili, and Kibera is one of Africa's largest informal settlements. It is a place facing intense economic struggles, where nearly a million people live under extreme conditions and official municipal infrastructure is scarce. Before Professor Ferretto and his team arrived, nobody could imagine the possibility of a public space where children could play and learn, locals could gather and dance, and women could work and earn.

Lab to Society | Monthly Pulse (October 2026)
Voices of the CU-riosities
Starting from zero to build a book house in Africa — How?
"We hope this building gives Kibera's children a place to play, learn, and belong, it can show the world and the next generation of architects that design has the power to change lives," said Associate Professor Peter Winston Ferretto, Director of the School of Architecture at CUHK, who led the project, summing up his and his students' aspiration in a few words.
The project is called the Amani Kibera Book House. "Amani" means peace in Swahili, and Kibera is one of Africa's largest informal settlements. It is a place facing intense economic struggles, where nearly a million people live under extreme conditions and official municipal infrastructure is scarce. Before Professor Ferretto and his team arrived, nobody could imagine the possibility of a public space where children could play and learn, locals could gather and dance, and women could work and earn.

---------------------------------------------------
Dear students,
The collaborative study between CUHK and UST is recruiting the last batch of participants! If you are interested, please enrol in this study now!
We are inviting undergraduate students to take part in a study exploring the relationship between emotion and learning experience. If you are (1)
over 18 years old
, (2) are an
undergraduate student
, (3) have
lived in Hong Kong for at least 3 years
, and (4) can
read Traditional Chinese and speak Cantonese fluently
, please read on!
INCENTIVES
If you can complete Part 1, Part 3, Part 4 and at least 80% of the daily surveys in Part 2 for this study, you will receive HKD$300 supermarket e-coupon.
WHAT TO DO?
Part 1: Please complete a 15-minute survey now:
https://ust.az1.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_cFGMgIN5ZBDU3jM
Upon the completion of Part 1, you can download or update surveyYIK (iOS ver. 1.4.2 & Android ver. 1.4.1.97).
Part 2: Starting tomorrow (till 31 Dec), we will send you a notification each evening at 8pm during which you will complete a short survey
before midnight
.
Part 3: In early Jan 2027, you will complete a 30-minute survey.
Part 4: In late Jan 2027, you will complete another 10-minute survey.
Please contact Jasmine via email at
happyu@ust.hk
or WhatsApp at 2358-5050 if you have any questions.
Note
:
Please ignore this email if you have completed the survey through previous recruitments. No extra compensation will be distributed to repeated participants
.
Best regards,
Jasmine Wong
HKUST Emotion and Personality Research Group

Click the link below to register and complete an initial questionnaire (approx. 10 minutes).

[16 Oct Anthropology Friday Seminar] Anne-Christine Trémon, "Regrets of the future. Critiques of unfulfilled promises and fake urbanization in Shenzhen."  - Anthropology
From: M.W.Leung
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
anthropology@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Dear all,
You are cordially invited to join a talk on 16 October, in which Prof. Anne-Christine Trémon will discuss inhabitants' critique of urban transformation in urbanized villages in Shenzhen, China.
Title: Regrets of the future. Critiques of unfulfilled promises and fake urbanization in Shenzhen.
Speaker: Anne-Christine Trémon (School for Advanced Studies in the Social Sciences (EHESS))
Date: Friday 16 October, 2026
Time: 1:00-2:30pm
Mode: In-person
Venue: Room 114, Humanities Building, New Asia College, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Abstract:
In Shenzhen as elsewhere in China the effects of the country's dramatic real estate crisis have unleashed changes that were striking amid my revisit to the field after years of absence. In this talk, I analyse the critical discourse I encountered regarding not only failed real estate projects, but also urban transformation itself. Among the inhabitants of urbanized villages in Shenzhen's periphery, the prevailing mood has shifted from optimism during my earlier field work to pessimism, and even outspoken resentment. Comparing the situation before and after the crisis allows pinpointing precisely where their shift in attitude lies. It also allows highlighting that critical discourse is not limited to moral outrage. People do not simply blame unfulfilled promises, they expose the fakeness of urbanisation policies, which they no longer view as a motor for growth and progress toward the future. Overall, I argue that inhabitants' critique is related to their no longer being in sync with urbanization: to their simultaneous feeling of stagnation and being out of step with the present.
